body:
create trigger PREINS_ORI
on R5ORIGINATORS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ORI_CODE, ORI_DESC, ORI_CLASS, ORI_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7PREORI N'INS', N'ORI', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREORI', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'ORIG', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ORP
on R5OPREPORTS
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nId            	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sName         		nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sOrg           	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sType          	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sTicket        	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sAudituser     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dAudittimestamp	datetime            
	declare @nUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)  
	declare @nPublic			numeric(1,0) 
	declare @sCreatedbyuser		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nSqlidentity   	integer     
	declare @dLastuploadtime	datetime        

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	ORP_ID,	ORP_NAME,	ORP_ORG,	ORP_TYPE,	ORP_TICKET,
													  	ORP_AUDITUSER,	ORP_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	ORP_PUBLIC, ORP_CREATEDBYUSER, ORP_LASTUPLOADTIME, ORP_UPDATECOUNT,	ORP_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@sName,	@sOrg,	@sType,	@sTicket,
												@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nPublic, @sCreatedbyuser, @dLastuploadtime, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @dAudittimestamp = getdate()
						end
					insert into R5OPREPORTS(	ORP_ID,	ORP_NAME,	ORP_ORG,	ORP_TYPE,	ORP_TICKET,
								            	ORP_AUDITUSER,	ORP_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	ORP_PUBLIC, ORP_CREATEDBYUSER, ORP_LASTUPLOADTIME, ORP_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@nId,	@sName,	@sOrg,	@sType,	@sTicket,
									    	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nPublic, @sCreatedbyuser, @dLastuploadtime, @nUpdatecount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@sName,	@sOrg,	@sType,	@sTicket,
														@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,	@nPublic, @sCreatedbyuser, @dLastuploadtime, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ORT
on R5ORDERTERMS
instead of insert
as
	declare @sUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sCODE         nvarchar (30)  
	declare @sDESC         nvarchar (80)
	declare @sTYPE         nvarchar (4)
	declare @sRTYPE        nvarchar (4)
	declare @sORG          nvarchar (15)
	declare @nUPDATECOUNT  numeric (38)   
    
    declare @sNotused       nvarchar(1)
    declare @sStCode        nvarchar(80)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ORT_CODE, ORT_DESC, ORT_TYPE, ORT_RTYPE, ORT_ORG, ORT_UPDATECOUNT, ORT_NOTUSED, ORT_STCODE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null
			open c_inserted

			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @sORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sNotused, @sStCode

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							IF @sTYPE IS NULL 
								set @sRTYPE = NULL
							ELSE
								begin
									if @sRTYPE is null 
										begin
											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sRTYPE OUTPUT, @sTYPE, N'OTTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													rollback transaction
													RETURN
												end

											if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
												set @sX = NULL
											else
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'O7RCODE', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

										end
								end


						end
					insert into R5ORDERTERMS	(	ORT_CODE, ORT_DESC, ORT_TYPE, ORT_RTYPE, ORT_ORG, ORT_UPDATECOUNT, ORT_NOTUSED, ORT_STCODE)
					    values ( @sCODE, @sDESC, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @sORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sNotused, @sStCode ) 

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sTYPE, @sRTYPE, @sORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sNotused, @sStCode
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_OSL
on R5OPSERVERLOG
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nId         	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dDatestamp  	datetime            
	declare @sFacility   	nvarchar(10)         
	declare @sSeverity   	nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sMessage    	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer 

	declare @nReturn		integer 
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)           

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	OSL_ID,	OSL_DATESTAMP,	OSL_FACILITY,	OSL_SEVERITY,	OSL_MESSAGE,
													  	OSL_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@dDatestamp,	@sFacility,	@sSeverity,	@sMessage,
												@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
						    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nId OUTPUT, N'OSL', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
						    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
							    begin
								    close c_inserted
								    deallocate c_inserted
								    rollback transaction
								    return
							    end

                                set @dDatestamp = getdate() 
                                
                                end

					insert into R5OPSERVERLOG(	OSL_ID,	OSL_DATESTAMP,	OSL_FACILITY,	OSL_SEVERITY,	OSL_MESSAGE)
								              
								values (	@nId,	@dDatestamp,	@sFacility,	@sSeverity,	@sMessage
									    
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nId,	@dDatestamp,	@sFacility,	@sSeverity,	@sMessage,
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PBC
on R5PROJBUDCODES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select PBC_CODE, PBC_DESC, PBC_CLASS, PBC_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0
							execute @nReturn = O7PREPBC N'INS', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPBC', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PBUD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PCL
on R5PROJBUDCLASSES
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sProject     	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sProjbud     	nvarchar(20)         
	declare @nAmount      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sAccount     	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sCostarea    	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sCostcenter  	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nEtc         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sSourcesystem	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sSourcecode  	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @dInterface   	datetime            
	declare @dCreated     	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated     	datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer   
	declare @sPCLSubaccount	nvarchar(8)                   

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	PCL_PROJECT,	PCL_PROJBUD,	PCL_AMOUNT,	PCL_ACCOUNT,	PCL_CLASS,
													  	PCL_CLASS_ORG,	PCL_COSTAREA,	PCL_COSTCENTER,	PCL_DESC,	PCL_ETC,
													  	PCL_UPDATECOUNT,	PCL_SOURCESYSTEM,	PCL_SOURCECODE,	PCL_INTERFACE,	PCL_CREATED,
													  	PCL_UPDATED,	PCL_SQLIDENTITY, PCL_SUBACCOUNT
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null
			set @nCountit = 0


			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sProject,	@sProjbud,	@nAmount,	@sAccount,	@sClass,
												@sClass_org,	@sCostarea,	@sCostcenter,	@sDesc,	@nEtc,
												@nUpdatecount,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@dInterface,	@dCreated,
												@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity, @sPCLSubaccount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PREPCL N'INS', @sProject, @sProjbud, @nAmount, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPCL', N'PROC',@sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF @sDesc IS NULL 
								BEGIN
									SELECT @sDesc = pbc_desc
									FROM   r5projbudcodes
									WHERE  pbc_code = @sProjbud;
								END

						--XMLOUT_POSINSUPD_PCL
							set @sFlag = N'N'

							SELECT @sFlag = coalesce(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE =	N'@SYNCPRJ'

							IF @sFlag = N'Y' 
								begin
									SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*) FROM R5PROJECTS WHERE (PRJ_RSTATUS = N'O'
																AND PRJ_SOURCESYSTEM IS NULL 
																AND PRJ_CODE = @sProject)
									IF (@nCount > 0)  
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											SELECT @sOrg = PRJ_ORG FROM R5PROJECTS WHERE PRJ_CODE = @sProject
											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS (XTS_TRANTYPE, XTS_TABLE, XTS_KEYFLD1, XTS_ORG, XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
											VALUES(N'SYNCPRJ', N'R5PROJECTS', @sProject, @sOrg, @sTempMsgid			)
										end
								end

						end
					insert into R5PROJBUDCLASSES(	PCL_PROJECT,	PCL_PROJBUD,	PCL_AMOUNT,	PCL_ACCOUNT,	PCL_CLASS,
								                 	PCL_CLASS_ORG,	PCL_COSTAREA,	PCL_COSTCENTER,	PCL_DESC,	PCL_ETC,
								                 	PCL_UPDATECOUNT,	PCL_SOURCESYSTEM,	PCL_SOURCECODE,	PCL_INTERFACE,	PCL_CREATED,
								                 	PCL_UPDATED, PCL_SUBACCOUNT)
								values (	@sProject,	@sProjbud,	@nAmount,	@sAccount,	@sClass,
											@sClass_org,	@sCostarea,	@sCostcenter,	@sDesc,	@nEtc,
											@nUpdatecount,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@dInterface,	@dCreated,
									    	@dUpdated, @sPCLSubaccount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sProject,	@sProjbud,	@nAmount,	@sAccount,	@sClass,
														@sClass_org,	@sCostarea,	@sCostcenter,	@sDesc,	@nEtc,
														@nUpdatecount,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@dInterface,	@dCreated,
														@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity, @sPCLSubaccount
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

             peq_status, peq_mrc, peq_location, peq_location_org, peq_costcode,

      FROM   INSERTED
      SET @sUser = dbo.o7gtsusr()
      IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
        BEGIN
          OPEN  c_inserted 
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO 
                @sMp, @sMp_org, @nRevision, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sOrg,
                @sStatus, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org, @sCostcode,
                @sPerson, @dDeactive, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse, 
                @sSchedgrp, @sSet, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @sRoute,
                @sIncludeNonconformities, @sDueNonconformitiesOnly
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN

              SET @dCreated = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )

              INSERT INTO r5patternequipment( 
                     peq_mp, peq_mp_org, peq_revision, peq_object, peq_object_org, peq_org,

              VALUES( @sMp, @sMp_org, @nRevision, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sOrg,
                      @sStatus, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org, @sCostcode,
                      @sPerson, @dDeactive, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse, 
                      @sSchedgrp, @sSet, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @sRoute,
                      @sIncludeNonconformities, @sDueNonconformitiesOnly )

              FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO  
                    @sMp, @sMp_org, @nRevision, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sOrg,
                    @sStatus, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocation_org, @sCostcode,
                    @sPerson, @dDeactive, @dDormstart, @dDormend, @sDormreuse, 
                    @sSchedgrp, @sSet, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @sRoute,
                    @sIncludeNonconformities, @sDueNonconformitiesOnly

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_PFA
ON r5partfailures
FOR INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
DECLARE @sUser       NVARCHAR( 38 )
DECLARE @nIdentity   INT
IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT pfa_sqlidentity FROM inserted
    SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
    IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
      BEGIN
        OPEN c_inserted 
        FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @nIdentity
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          BEGIN
            UPDATE r5partfailures
            SET    pfa_updated = getdate()
            WHERE  pfa_sqlidentity = @nIdentity
            FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @nIdentity
          END
        CLOSE c_inserted
      END
  END

						begin

											end

										if @nCountit >= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0 
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_PMP', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PPMP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sObjectClass, @sObjectClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	declare @sPpm        	nvarchar(20)

	declare @nSqlidentity	integer

		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	PPL_LINE,	PPL_OBJECT,	PPL_OBJORG,	PPL_PPM,	PPL_NESTINGREF,
													  	PPL_UPDATECOUNT,	PPL_SQLIDENTITY, PPL_SESSIONID
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nLine,	@sObject,	@sObjorg,	@sPpm,	@sNestingref,
												@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @nSessionid
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin

										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return

								end

						end

														@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @nSessionid
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PRI
on R5PRICECODES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select PRI_CODE, PRI_DESC, PRI_CLASS, PRI_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PRIC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_PRI', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC',@sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PRIC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PRT
on R5PERMITS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int
    declare @sKeyCode       nvarchar(40)
    declare @nRevision      int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select PRT_CODE, PRT_Org, PRT_DESC, PRT_CLASS, PRT_CLASS_ORG, PRT_REVISION from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @nRevision
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							/* W13221 : Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'PERM' ) */
							If @sClass is not null
								begin

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PERM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_PRT', N'TRIG', 1, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end


							/* W45201 - Insert description */
							set @sKeyCode = @sCode + '#' + CAST(@nRevision AS nvarchar(4))
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PERM', @sX, N'*', @sKeyCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @nRevision
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PRV
on R5PROPERTYVALUES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sProperty		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(100)
	declare @nSeqno			numeric(38)
	declare @sValue			nvarchar(40)
	declare	@nValue			numeric(24,6)
	declare @dValue			datetime
	declare @sOldValue		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@nOldValue		numeric(24,6)
	declare @dOldValue		datetime
	declare @sAudit			nvarchar(1)	--r5entities.ent_caaudit%TYPE
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCoalesced		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sOldCoalesced	nvarchar(255)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sFormdat		nvarchar(200)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	PRV_PROPERTY, PRV_RENTITY, PRV_CLASS, PRV_CODE, 
														PRV_SEQNO, PRV_VALUE, PRV_NVALUE, PRV_DVALUE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sCode, @nSeqno, @sValue, @nValue, @dValue
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PROP_PREPRV N'INS', @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sCode, null, @nSeqno, @sValue, null, @nValue, NULL, @dValue, NULL
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							if @dValue is not null
								begin
									select @sType = pro_type from r5properties where pro_code = @sProperty
									if @sType = N'DATE'
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATE'), N'DD-MON-RRRR')
									else
										set @sFormdat = isnull(dbo.o7dflt2(N'FORMDATI'), N'DD-MON-RRRR HH24:MI:SS')
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW PORTION
							SELECT @sAudit = coalesce( ent_caaudit, N'-' )
							  FROM r5entities
							 WHERE ent_rentity = @sRentity

							if @sAudit = N'+' and @sCode is not null
								begin
									set @sCoalesced = coalesce( @sValue, coalesce( cast(@nValue as nvarchar), dbo.f_date_to_char(@dValue, @sFormdat) ) )
									set @sConcat = @sRentity + N' ' + @sCode
									execute @nReturn = O7AUDIT 0, N'INSERT', N'R5PROPERTYVALUES', NULL, @sCoalesced, @sProperty, @sConcat, @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							--Reset work order esignature information
							if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								DELETE FROM r5eventsignature WHERE ets_event = @sCode and ets_updatecount <> -999
							end								
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sCode, @nSeqno, @sValue, @nValue, @dValue
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

			set @sX = NULL

				begin

											 @sPart,
											 @sPart_org,

											 @nRecvqty,
											 @nMultiply,

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							UPDATE r5orderlines
							SET    orl_dckrecvqty = Coalesce(orl_dckrecvqty, 0) + @nRecvqty
							WHERE  orl_order      = @sOrder

							AND    orl_part       = @sPart
							AND    orl_part_org   = @sPart_org


							fetch next from c_inserted into

													 @sOrder_org,
													 @sPart,
													 @sPart_org,
													 @sManlot,
													 @dManlotexp,
													 @sSupplierref,
													 @sDeluom,
													 @nDelqty,
													 @nRecvqty,
													 @nMultiply,
													 @sComment,
													 @nUpdatecount,
													 @nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_PTP
on R5POINTTYPES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(30)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer    
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select
												   ptp_code,
												   ptp_desc,
												   ptp_class,
												   ptp_class_org,
												   ptp_updatecount,
												   ptp_sqlidentity
											from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into 
									 @sCode,
									 @sDesc,
									 @sClass,
									 @sClass_org,
									 @nUpdatecount,
									 @nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PNTP', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_PTP', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'PNTP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into 
											 @sCode,
											 @sDesc,
											 @sClass,
											 @sClass_org,
											 @nUpdatecount,
											 @nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create procedure PREINS_QULEXCH	@sQuotation	nvarchar(30),
								@sSeqno		nvarchar(2),
								@sCurr		nvarchar(3),
								@nPrice		numeric(24,6),
								@nTodual	numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
								@nFromdual	numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nExch		numeric(24,12)
	declare @sExchorg	nvarchar(15)	--r5quotations.quo_org%TYPE
	declare @dQuodate	datetime		--r5quotations.quo_date%TYPE
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @nCalc		numeric(24,6)

	select	@sExchorg = QUO_ORG,
			@dQuodate = QUO_DATE
	  FROM  r5quotations
	 WHERE  quo_code  = @sQuotation
	 AND    quo_seqno = @sSeqno

	set @nCalc = isnull( @nPrice, 1000 )
	execute @nReturn = O7GTDUAL @sCurr, @nCalc, @nTodual OUTPUT, @nFromdual OUTPUT, @nExch OUTPUT, @sExchorg, @dQuodate
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sSeqno       	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sStatus      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sType        	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sSupplier    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sLang        	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sStore       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sAuth        	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOrigin      	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDocref      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dDate        	datetime            
	declare @dDue         	datetime            
	declare @dRecv        	datetime            
	declare @dExpir       	datetime            
	declare @nLeadtime    	numeric(4,1)        
	declare @nTotal       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sCurr        	nvarchar(3)         
	declare @nExch        	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @sRating      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nScore       	numeric(2,0)        
	declare @sPrinted     	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrder       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sBuyer       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sBlanket     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg         	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nExchtodual  	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @nExchfromdual	numeric(24,12)      
	declare @sDeladdress  	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sSupplier_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOrder_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer             

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nErecord		int
	declare @sGetUser		nvarchar(255)
	declare @dGtTime		datetime
	declare @sGetStype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sCertnum		nvarchar(20)	--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certification%TYPE
	declare @sCerttype		nvarchar(8)		--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%

	declare @nTodual   		numeric(24,12)      
	declare @nFromdual 		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nTempExch		integer 	
	declare @sSeqno1		nvarchar(30)
	declare @dLastsav		datetime
		



	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	QUO_CODE,	QUO_SEQNO,	QUO_DESC,	QUO_CLASS,	QUO_STATUS,
													  	QUO_RSTATUS,	QUO_TYPE,	QUO_RTYPE,	QUO_SUPPLIER,	QUO_LANG,
													  	QUO_STORE,	QUO_AUTH,	QUO_ORIGIN,	QUO_DOCREF,	QUO_DATE,
													  	QUO_DUE,	QUO_RECV,	QUO_EXPIR,	QUO_LEADTIME,	QUO_TOTAL,
													  	QUO_CURR,	QUO_EXCH,	QUO_RATING,	QUO_SCORE,	QUO_PRINTED,
													  	QUO_ORDER,	QUO_BUYER,	QUO_BLANKET,	QUO_ORG,	QUO_EXCHTODUAL,
													  	QUO_EXCHFROMDUAL,	QUO_DELADDRESS,	QUO_CLASS_ORG,	QUO_SUPPLIER_ORG,	QUO_ORDER_ORG,
													  	QUO_UPDATECOUNT,	QUO_SQLIDENTITY,QUO_LASTSAVED
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sSeqno,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sStatus,
												@sRstatus,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@sSupplier,	@sLang,
												@sStore,	@sAuth,	@sOrigin,	@sDocref,	@dDate,
												@dDue,	@dRecv,	@dExpir,	@nLeadtime,	@nTotal,
												@sCurr,	@nExch,	@sRating,	@nScore,	@sPrinted,
												@sOrder,	@sBuyer,	@sBlanket,	@sOrg,	@nExchtodual,
												@nExchfromdual,	@sDeladdress,	@sClass_org,	@sSupplier_org,	@sOrder_org,
												@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dLastsav
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							--preins
							execute @nReturn = o7prequo N'INS', @sOrg, @sCode, @sSeqno, @dDue, @dDate OUTPUT, @sOrder OUTPUT, @sOrder_org OUTPUT,
									 @sAuth OUTPUT, @dRecv OUTPUT , @dExpir OUTPUT, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT,
									 @sType OUTPUT, @nTotal OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREQUO', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7CKOCOM @sOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7CKOCOM', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sRstatus = N'U' 
								begin
									set @sAuth  = NULL
									set @dRecv  = NULL
									set @dExpir = NULL
								end
							set @sOrder     = NULL
							set @sOrder_org = NULL


							--preins_quoexch
							execute @nReturn = O7GTDUAL @sCurr, 1000, @nTodual OUTPUT, @nFromdual OUTPUT, @nTempExch OUTPUT, @sOrg, @dDate
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							set @nExchtodual		= 	@nTodual
							set @nExchfromdual		=	@nFromdual


							--posins
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', @sX, N'QUOT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'NEW', N'QUOT',  N'-', @sStatus
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno1 OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									
									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O

create trigger PREINS_QUT
on R5QUOTTASKS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sQuotation		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSeqno			nvarchar(2)
	declare @sTrade			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nCountit		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select QUT_QUOTATION, QUT_SEQNO, QUT_TRADE from inserted
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCountit = 0

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @sTrade
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTQ N'QUOT', N'*',  @sQuotation,  N'TRD', @sSeqno, @sTrade, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


								if @nCountit >= 0
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0 
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'PREINS_QUT', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											set @sX = null
									end
								else
									begin
										if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTQ', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTQ N'QUOT', N'*',  @sQuotation,  N'STAT', @sSeqno, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


								if @nCountit >= 0
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0 
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'PREINS_QUT', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											set @sX = null
									end
								else
									begin
										if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTQ', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sQuotation, @sSeqno, @sTrade
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_R5EVENTS_PASSTHROUGH
on R5EVENTS_PASSTHROUGH
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sProc          nvarchar(32)
    declare @sMode			nvarchar(6)
    declare @sOldrstatus	nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)

    declare @nPpmrev		numeric(4)
    declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)
    declare @nFreq			numeric(8)
    declare @sObject		nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObject_org	nvarchar(15)
    declare @sPerioduom		nvarchar(10)
    declare @sMetuom		nvarchar(30)
    declare @sMetuom2		nvarchar(30)
    declare @sStatus		nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRoute			nvarchar(20) 
    declare @nPpopk         integer 
    declare @sRouteparent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sMultiequip	nvarchar(1)
    declare @dCompleted		datetime	
    declare @sReqm			nvarchar(8)
    declare @sAction		nvarchar(8)
    declare @sCause			nvarchar(8)
    declare @sFailure		nvarchar(8)
    declare @sIsstype       nvarchar(1)
    declare @sLoc			nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sLocorg		nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sStwo			nvarchar(20)
    declare @sAlert			nvarchar(30)
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(6)
    declare @nError         int
    declare @sJob_type      nvarchar(8)
    declare @nFrompoint     numeric( 24, 6 )
    declare @nTopoint       numeric( 24, 6 )
    declare @sOldRoute		nvarchar(20) 
    declare @sOldObj		nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sOldObjorg		nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sOldLoc		nvarchar(30) 
    declare @sOldLocorg		nvarchar(15) 
    declare @sOldStwo		nvarchar(20) 
    declare @sOldAlert		nvarchar(30) 
    declare @nOldFrompoint	numeric(24,6)
    declare @nOldTopoint	numeric(24,6)
    declare @dReported		datetime	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select PROCNAME, MODE, OLDRSTATUS, CODE, ORG, PPM, PPMREV,
                                                       RSTATUS, FREQ, OBJECT, OBJECT_ORG, LOCATION, LOCATIONORG,
                                                       PERIODUOM, METUOM, METUOM2, STATUS, STANDWORK,ALERT,
                                                       ROUTE, PPOPK, ROUTEPARENT, MULTIEQUIP,
                                                       COMPLETED, REQM, ACTION, CAUSE, FAILURE, ISSTYPE, OLDROUTE, REPORTED,
                                                       OLDOBJECT, OLDOBJECT_ORG, OLDLOCATION, OLDLOCATION_ORG, OLDSTANDWORK,
                                                       OLDALERT,  OLDFROMPOINT, OLDTOPOINT, JOBTYPE, FROMPOINT, TOPOINT
                                                from inserted
            open c_inserted
            fetch next from c_inserted into @sProc, @sMode, @sOldrstatus, @sCode, @sOrg, @sPpm, @nPpmrev,
                                            @sRstatus, @nFreq, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sLoc, @sLocorg,
                                            @sPerioduom, @sMetuom, @sMetuom2, @sStatus, @sStwo, @sAlert,
                                            @sRoute, @nPpopk, @sRouteparent, @sMultiequip, 
                                            @dCompleted, @sReqm, @sAction, @sCause, @sFailure, @sIsstype, @sOldRoute, @dReported,
                                            @sOldObj, @sOldObjorg, @sOldLoc,@sOldLocorg, @sOldStwo,@sOldAlert,
                                            @nOldFrompoint, @nOldTopoint, @sJob_type, @nFrompoint, @nTopoint


			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
                    if @sProc = N'O7POSEVT'
                        begin
					        execute @nReturn = O7POSEVT @sMode, @sOldrstatus, @sCode, @sOrg, @sPpm, @nPpmrev,
                                                        @sRstatus, @nFreq, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sPerioduom,
                                                        @sMetuom, @sMetuom2, @sStatus, @sRoute, @nPpopk, 
                                                        @sRouteparent, @sMultiequip, @dCompleted, @sReqm, 
                                                        @sAction, @sCause, @sFailure, @sIsstype, @sLoc, @sLocorg, @sStwo,
                                                        @sAlert, @sJob_type, @nFrompoint, @nTopoint,
                                                        @sOldRoute, @sOldObj, @sOldObjorg, @sOldLoc, @sOldLocorg, @sOldStwo, 
                                                        @sOldAlert, @nOldFrompoint, @nOldTopoint, @dReported
					        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
						        begin
							        close c_inserted
							        deallocate c_inserted
							        rollback transaction
							        return
						        end

                            delete from r5events_passthrough
                            where  code     = @sCode
                            and    procname = N'O7POSEVT'

                        end

                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sProc, @sMode, @sOldrstatus, @sCode, @sOrg, @sPpm, @nPpmrev,
                                            		@sRstatus, @nFreq, @sObject, @sObject_org, @sLoc, @sLocorg,
                                            		@sPerioduom, @sMetuom, @sMetuom2, @sStatus, @sStwo, @sAlert,
                                            		@sRoute, @nPpopk, @sRouteparent, @sMultiequip, 
                                            		@dCompleted, @sReqm, @sAction, @sCause, @sFailure, @sIsstype, @sOldRoute, @dReported,
                                            		@sOldObj, @sOldObjorg, @sOldLoc,@sOldLocorg, @sOldStwo,@sOldAlert,
                                            		@nOldFrompoint, @nOldTopoint, @sJob_type, @nFrompoint, @nTopoint
                end

            close c_inserted
            deallocate c_inserted
        end

create trigger PREINS_RCL
on R5REQCLASSES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sGen			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sReqm		nvarchar(8)  -- r5actioncodes.acc_gen%TYPE;
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select RCL_CLASS, RCL_CLASS_ORG, RCL_REQM from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sReqm
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* A07121 : Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'OBJ' ) */
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit >= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RCL', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							SELECT @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5requircodes 
							WHERE  rqm_code = @sReqm


							/* A07123 : Requirement Code can't be general (r5requircodes) */
							if @nCount <= 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RCL', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									SELECT @sGen = rqm_gen
									FROM   r5requircodes 
									WHERE  rqm_code = @sReqm
									
									if @sGen = N'+'
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RCL', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sReqm
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

    declare @installchangefound int
    declare @wocompletefound    int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			execute @nReturn = R5O7CONS_VALUE_OF @sInspflag OUTPUT, N'MODULE', N'I'
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select  REA_METER, REA_DATE, REA_READING, REA_OBTYPE, REA_OBRTYPE, REA_OBJECT, REA_DIFF, REA_UOM, REA_PARENT,
														REA_CALCUOM, REA_RECORDED, REA_SOURCESYSTEM, REA_SOURCECODE, REA_TRANSORGID, REA_TRANSCODE, 
														REA_TRANSGROUP, REA_OBJECT_ORG, REA_CODE, REA_EVENT, REA_RELATEDEVENT, REA_UPDATECOUNT, REA_CREATED,
														REA_UPDATED, REA_TYPE from inserted

			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sMETER, @dDATE , @nREADING, @sOBTYPE, @sOBRTYPE , @sOBJECT  , @nDIFF, @sUOM, @sPARENT, @sCALCUOM, @dRECORDED, 
											@sSOURCESYSTEM , @sSOURCECODE , @nTRANSORGID , @sTRANSCODE , @nTRANSGROUP , @sOBJECT_ORG , @sCODE , @sEVENT, @sRELATEDEVENT, @nUPDATECOUNT, @dCreated,	
											@dUpdated, @sType   


			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @sCODE is null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nCode OUTPUT, N'REA', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									set @sCODE = cast (@nCode as nvarchar(30))
								end

							if @sPARENT is null
								begin
									/* Set type, 'D' for Difference or 'A' for Absolute. */
									if @nDIFF is not null
										set @sType = N'D'
									else
										set @sType = N'A'
								end

							select @sUpdownmeter = oud_updownmeter,
									@sOudmeter = oud_meter
							from   r5objusagedefs
							where  oud_object     = @sOBJECT
							and    oud_object_org = @sOBJECT_ORG
							and    oud_uom        = ISNULL( @sUOM, @sCALCUOM )

							/* Store original entered difference and reading. */
							SET @nDIFFORIG = @nDIFF
							SET @nREADINGORIG = @nREADING

							/* Call to procedure o7prerea procedure */
							execute @nReturn = o7prerea  N'INS', @dDATE, @nREADING OUTPUT, @sMETER, @sUOM, @sOBJECT, @sOBJECT_ORG, @nDIFF OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREREA', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					insert into R5READINGS	( REA_METER, REA_DATE, REA_READING, REA_OBTYPE, REA_OBRTYPE, REA_OBJECT, REA_DIFF, REA_UOM, REA_PARENT,
												REA_CALCUOM, REA_RECORDED, REA_SOURCESYSTEM, REA_SOURCECODE, REA_TRANSORGID, REA_TRANSCODE, 
												REA_TRANSGROUP, REA_OBJECT_ORG, REA_CODE, REA_EVENT, REA_RELATEDEVENT, REA_UPDATECOUNT, REA_CREATED, REA_UPDATED, REA_TYPE )
					values (	@sMETER, @dDATE , @nREADING, @sOBTYPE, @sOBRTYPE , @sOBJECT  , @nDIFF, @sUOM, @sPARENT, @sCALCUOM, @dRECORDED, 
								@sSOURCESYSTEM , @sSOURCECODE , @nTRANSORGID , @sTRANSCODE , @nTRANSGROUP , @sOBJECT_ORG , @sCODE , @sEVENT, @sRELATEDEVENT, @nUPDATECOUNT, @dCreated, @dUpdated, @sType )

					IF ISNULL( @sUpdownmeter, N'-' ) = N'-'
						BEGIN
							/* Below code comes from the new Oracle compound trigger. */
							IF @nDIFFORIG IS NOT NULL AND @sType = N'D'
								BEGIN
									/* Difference used. */
									/* Update all later readings. */
									UPDATE r5readings  
									SET    rea_reading = ISNULL( ( SELECT ( rea_reading + @nDIFFORIG ) % ( met_max + 1 )
																FROM   r5meters
																WHERE  met_code = rea_meter ),  rea_reading + @nDIFFORIG )
									WHERE  rea_object     = @sOBJECT 
									AND    rea_object_org = @sOBJECT_ORG
									AND    rea_calcuom    = ISNULL( @sUOM, @sCALCUOM )
									AND    rea_date       > @dDATE
									IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
										BEGIN
											/* Get data from next reading. */
											SELECT TOP 1 @nNextreading = rea_reading - rea_diff, 
												@sReacode    = rea_code, 
												@nReareading = rea_reading, 
												@nMetmax     = met_max, 
												@nReadiff    = rea_diff
											FROM   r5readings
												LEFT OUTER JOIN r5meters ON ( met_code = rea_meter )
											WHERE  rea_object     = @sOBJECT
											AND    rea_object_org = @sOBJECT_ORG
											AND    rea_calcuom    = ISNULL( @sUOM, @sCALCUOM )
											AND    rea_date       > @dDATE
											ORDER BY rea_date
		
											IF @nNextreading < 0 
												/* There was a rollover. */
												SET @nNextreading = @nMetmax + 1 - ( @nReadiff - @nReareading )
											/* Update next reading. */
											UPDATE r5readings
											SET    rea_reading = @nNextreading
											WHERE  rea_code = @sCODE
                                            /* Update total usage and oud_notlast. */
                                            /* oud_notlast Flag Values '-' indicates both sinceinstall and sincelastwork values to be updated      */
                                            /* '+' none of these fields to be updated, 'I' only sinceinstall value and 'W' only sincelastwo value. */
                                            SELECT @installchangefound =  COUNT( * ) FROM r5events
                                            WHERE  evt_object          =  @sOBJECT
                                            AND    evt_object_org      =  @sOBJECT_ORG
                                            AND    evt_rstatus         =  'C'

create trigger PREINS_RES
on R5RESERVATIONS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFlag			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sQty			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sAllQty		nvarchar(80)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nAllQty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity	int
	declare @sProject		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select RES_EVENT, RES_ACT, RES_PART, RES_PART_ORG, RES_PROJECT, RES_STORE, RES_QTY, RES_ALLQTY, RES_UPDATECOUNT, RES_SQLIDENTITY												  from	inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
				--BEFORE EACH ROW portion

					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty ,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7PRERES N'INS', @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRERES', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							/* S3838 - Delete dependant data */
							
							select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							if @nCount > 0 
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCRES'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'

							if @sFlag = N'Y'
								begin

									EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
									   XTS_TABLE,
									   XTS_KEYFLD1,
									   XTS_KEYFLD2,
									   XTS_KEYFLD3,
									   XTS_KEYFLD4,
									   XTS_KEYFLD5,
									   XTS_DATAFLD1,
									   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
									   XTS_ORG
									  )
									VALUES(
									  N'RESERVATIONS',
									  N'R5RESERVATIONS',
									  @sEvent,
									  @nAct,
									  @sPart,
									  @sPartorg,
									  @sStore,
									  N'A',
									  @sTempMsgid,
									  @sPartorg)
								end							  							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sEvent, @nAct, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sProject, @sStore, @nQty, @nAllQty ,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_RIS
on R5RISK
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @nPk         	integer    
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sRisk       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @nRevision   	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sRevrstatus 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRevstatus  	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sType       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nParent     	integer
	declare @sNormalize  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sRanklevel  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nRankvalue  	numeric(12,6)       
	declare @sNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFormula    	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sUserid		nvarchar(255)	--r5entappheader.eah_user%TYPE
	declare @dGtTime		datetime

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	RIS_PK,	RIS_CODE,	RIS_DESC,	RIS_RISK,	RIS_REVISION,
													  	RIS_CLASS,	RIS_CLASS_ORG,	RIS_REVRSTATUS,	RIS_REVSTATUS,	RIS_TYPE,
													  	RIS_PARENT,	RIS_NORMALIZE,	RIS_RANKLEVEL,	RIS_RANKVALUE,	RIS_NOTUSED,
													  	RIS_CREATED,	RIS_USER,	RIS_UPDATED,	RIS_UPDUSER,	RIS_FORMULA,
													  	RIS_UPDATECOUNT,	RIS_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nPk,	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sRisk,	@nRevision,
														@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
														@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
														@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
														@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PRERIS N'INS', @sClass, @sClass_org, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRERIS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSINS portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'RISK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							INSERT INTO r5entappheader ( eah_rentity, eah_code, eah_revision,
														  eah_user, eah_date )
							VALUES( N'RISK', @sCode, @nRevision, @sUserid, @dGtTime )

							fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nPk,	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sRisk,	@nRevision,
																@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@sType,
																@nParent,	@sNormalize,	@sRanklevel,	@nRankvalue,	@sNotused,
																@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@sFormula,
																@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_RJR
on R5REJECTREASONS
for insert
as

	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select RJR_CODE, RJR_DESC, RJR_CLASS, RJR_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null
			set @nCountit = 0

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'REJR', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0

													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RJR', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return

										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'REJR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_ROU
on R5ROUTES
instead of insert
as
	declare @sUsr_name		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
   	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sUstat			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_entity%TYPE;
	declare @sRstat			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCODE			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDESC			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCATEGORY		nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sTEMPLATE		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCLASS			nvarchar(8) 
	declare @nREVISION		numeric(4)  
	declare @sREVRSTATUS	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sREVSTATUS		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sORG			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCLASSORG		nvarchar(15) 
	declare @nUPDATECOUNT	numeric(38)  
	declare @sLinkgiswo		nvarchar(1)
 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			declare c_inserted cursor local for select ROU_CODE, ROU_DESC, ROU_CATEGORY, ROU_TEMPLATE, ROU_CLASS, ROU_REVISION, 
													ROU_REVRSTATUS, ROU_REVSTATUS, ROU_ORG, ROU_CLASS_ORG, ROU_UPDATECOUNT, ROU_LINKGISWO   from inserted
			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCATEGORY, @sTEMPLATE, @sCLASS, @nREVISION, 
											@sREVRSTATUS, @sREVSTATUS, @sORG, @sCLASSORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sLinkgiswo	


			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sCLASS is not null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST  N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sCLASS, @sCLASSORG,N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit > 0
										set @sX = null
									else
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ROU', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											else
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							If @sCATEGORY is not null 
								begin
									set @nCountit = 0
									select @nCountit = count(*) 
									FROM   r5objects o
									WHERE  o.obj_code      = @sCATEGORY
									AND    o.obj_class     = @sCLASS
									AND    o.obj_class_org = @sCLASSORG
									AND    o.obj_obrtype   = N'C'
									
									If @nCountit = 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_ROU', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end 

								end 

							If @sREVSTATUS is Null or @sREVRSTATUS is null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sX OUTPUT, N'PMRVCTRL', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									set @sX = UPPER(@sX)

									If coalesce (@sX, N'-') in ( N'+', N'ON', N'YES', N'Y' )
										set @sRstat = N'U'
									else
										set @sRstat = N'A'

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstat OUTPUT, @sRstat, N'RCST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									Set @sREVSTATUS = @sUstat
									Set @sREVRSTATUS = @sRstat
								end


							If @nREVISION is null 
								Select @nREVISION = coalesce(max(rou_revision), -1) + 1

								where rou_code = @sCODE

						end
					insert into R5ROUTES	(	ROU_CODE, ROU_DESC, ROU_CATEGORY, ROU_TEMPLATE, ROU_CLASS, ROU_REVISION, 
											ROU_REVRSTATUS, ROU_REVSTATUS, ROU_ORG, ROU_CLASS_ORG, ROU_UPDATECOUNT, ROU_LINKGISWO )
					values ( @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCATEGORY, @sTEMPLATE, @sCLASS, @nREVISION, 
								@sREVRSTATUS, @sREVSTATUS, @sORG, @sCLASSORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sLinkgiswo	 )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCATEGORY, @sTEMPLATE, @sCLASS, @nREVISION, 
													@sREVRSTATUS, @sREVSTATUS, @sORG, @sCLASSORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @sLinkgiswo	

				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create procedure PREINS_RQLEXCH	@sReq		nvarchar(30),
								@sCurr		nvarchar(3),

								@nTodual	numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,

as

	declare @sExchorg	nvarchar(15)	--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
	declare @dReqdate	datetime
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @nCalc		float

	select	@sExchorg = REQ_ORG,
			@dReqdate = REQ_DATE
	  FROM  r5requisitions

	if @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

create trigger PREINS_RQM
on R5REQUIRCODES
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select RQM_CODE, RQM_DESC, RQM_CLASS, RQM_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode,  @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

								If @sClass is not null
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'RECO', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit >= 0
											begin
												if @nCountit = 0 
													begin
														close c_inserted
														deallocate c_inserted
														execute O7RAE N'PREINS_RQM', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
														rollback transaction
														return
													end
											end
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'RECO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode,  @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_SDS
on R5SHUTDOWNS
for insert
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select SDS_CODE, SDS_DESC, SDS_ORG, SDS_CLASS, SDS_CLASS_ORG from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'SHUT', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_SDS', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'SHUT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	declare @nReturn		integer	
	declare @nCountit		integer	

	declare @sTypeent		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sStateent		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRoute			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nRouterev		numeric(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	SOB_SHUTDOWN,	SOB_OBTYPE,	SOB_OBRTYPE,	SOB_OBJECT,	SOB_DEPEND,
													  	SOB_STANDWORK,	SOB_PROJBUD,	SOB_OBJECT_ORG,	SOB_UPDATECOUNT,	SOB_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	SOB_ROUTE,	SOB_ROUTEREV
													  
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sShutdown,	@sObtype,	@sObrtype,	@sObject,	@sDepend,
												@sStandwork,	@sProjbud,	@sObject_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
												@sRoute,	@nRouterev
											
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTO N'OBJ', @sObtype, @sObject, N'TYPE', @sObject_org, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted

												rollback transaction
												return
											end

												if @sCheckresult <> N'0'

														deallocate c_inserted

														return

													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'O7CKSTTP', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return

											set @sObrtype = @sX

											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, @sTypeent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

													deallocate c_inserted
													rollback transaction
													return

															deallocate c_inserted

	declare @nCountResource		int
	declare @nSQLIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @chk			nvarchar(4)
		
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			select @nCount = count(*) from deleted
			if @nCount = 0
				--INSERTING
				begin
					declare c_inserted cursor local for select	STC_CHILDRTYPE, STC_PARENTRTYPE,	STC_CHILD,	STC_CHILD_ORG,
																STC_CHILDTYPE,	STC_ROLLDOWN,		STC_PARENT,	STC_PARENT_ORG,
																STC_PARENTTYPE,	STC_ROLLUP, stc_SQLIDENTITY
															from inserted
					set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
					if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							open c_inserted 
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sChildrtype, @sParentrtype, @sChild, @sChild_org, @sChildtype, 
															@sRolldown, @sParent, @sParent_org, @sParenttype, @sRollup, @nSQLIdentity 
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									select @nCount = count(*)
									FROM   r5invalstructures i,
											r5structures s
									WHERE  i.ist_rchild      = @sChildrtype
									AND    i.ist_newrparent  = @sParentrtype
									AND    i.ist_rparent     = s.stc_parentrtype
									AND    s.stc_child       = @sChild
									AND    s.stc_child_org   = @sChild_org
									AND    s.stc_childrtype  = @sChildrtype
									AND    s.stc_childtype   = @sChildtype

									if @nCount > 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_STC', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
										
									--check equipment resource conflict
									select @nCountResource = count(1)
									FROM   r5structures s1, r5objects o1
									WHERE  s1.stc_parent =  @sParent
									AND    s1.stc_parent_org = @sParent_org
									AND    s1.stc_child = @sChild
									AND    s1.stc_child_org = @sChild_org
									AND    s1.stc_parent = o1.obj_code
									AND    s1.stc_parent_org = o1.obj_org
									AND    o1.obj_resource = '+'
									AND    EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5structures s2, r5objects o
											WHERE  s2.stc_parent = o.obj_code
											AND    s2.stc_parent_org = o.obj_org
											AND    s2.stc_child =  s1.stc_child
											AND    s2.stc_child_org =s1.stc_child_org
											AND    (s2.stc_parent<> @sParent OR s2.stc_parent_org <> @sParent_org)
											AND    o.obj_resource = '+')

									if @nCountResource > 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_STC', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction

									if @sParentrtype = N'L'
										begin
