											set @sRolldown	= N'+'
										end

									--AFTER EACH ROW portion
									UPDATE r5objusagedefs
									SET    oud_sinceinstall = 0
									WHERE  oud_object     = @sChild
									AND    oud_object_org = @sChild_org

									if @sChildrtype = @sParentrtype
										UPDATE r5objects
										SET    obj_parent     = @sParent,
											   obj_parent_org = @sParent_org,
											   obj_depend     = @sRolldown
										WHERE  obj_code       = @sChild
										AND    obj_org        = @sChild_org

									if @sChildrtype = N'A' and @sParentrtype = N'P'
										UPDATE r5objects
										SET    obj_position     = @sParent,
											   obj_position_org = @sParent_org,
											   obj_ptype        = @sParenttype
										WHERE  obj_code         = @sChild
										AND    obj_org          = @sChild_org

									if @sParentrtype = N'L' or @sRolldown = N'+'
										UPDATE r5objects 
										SET    obj_location  = (
											   SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN N'L' THEN obj_code   ELSE obj_location END
											   FROM   r5objects 
											   WHERE  obj_code = @sParent
											   AND    obj_org  = @sParent_org ), 
											   obj_location_org   = (
											   SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN N'L' THEN obj_org    ELSE obj_location_org END
											   FROM   r5objects 
											   WHERE  obj_code = @sParent
											   AND    obj_org  = @sParent_org ),
											   obj_ltype = (
											   SELECT CASE obj_obrtype WHEN N'L' THEN obj_obtype ELSE obj_ltype END
											   FROM   r5objects 
											   WHERE  obj_code = @sParent
											   AND    obj_org  = @sParent_org )
										WHERE  obj_code      = @sChild
										AND    obj_org       = @sChild_org

									update r5structures set stc_rollup	= @sRollup, 
												stc_rolldown	= @sRolldown,
												stc_mnbdefinition = (	select obj_mnbdefinition
															from   r5objects
															where  obj_code = @sParent
															and    obj_org  = @sParent_org )
									where	stc_SQLIDENTITY	= @nSQLIdentity
																		
									fetch next from c_inserted into @sChildrtype, @sParentrtype, @sChild, @sChild_org, @sChildtype, 
																	@sRolldown, @sParent, @sParent_org, @sParenttype, @sRollup, @nSQLIdentity 
								end
							close c_inserted
						end
					deallocate c_inserted
					execute O7UPOBJGIS @sChildrtype, @sChild, @sChild_org, @sParentrtype, @sParent, @sParent_org, @chk
				end
			else
				--UPDATING
				begin
					declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.STC_CHILDRTYPE,	i.STC_PARENTRTYPE,	i.STC_CHILD,	i.STC_CHILD_ORG,
																i.STC_CHILDTYPE,	i.STC_ROLLDOWN,		i.STC_PARENT,	i.STC_PARENT_ORG,
																i.STC_PARENTTYPE,	i.STC_UPDATECOUNT,	i.STC_ROLLUP,
																d.STC_CHILDRTYPE,	d.STC_PARENTRTYPE,	d.STC_CHILD,	d.STC_CHILD_ORG,
																d.STC_CHILDTYPE,	d.STC_ROLLDOWN,		d.STC_PARENT,	d.STC_PARENT_ORG,
																d.STC_PARENTTYPE,	d.STC_UPDATECOUNT,	d.STC_ROLLUP, i.stc_SQLIDENTITY
														from inserted i, deleted d
														where	i.stc_SQLIDENTITY			= d.stc_SQLIDENTITY

CREATE TRIGGER PREINS_STT
ON R5STORETAXES
INSTEAD OF INSERT
AS
  DECLARE @sSysUser      NVARCHAR( 38 )
  DECLARE @sPK           NVARCHAR( 30 )        
  DECLARE @sStore        NVARCHAR( 15 )        
  DECLARE @sCommodity    NVARCHAR( 15 )        
  DECLARE @sTax          NVARCHAR( 20 )        
  DECLARE @nUpdatecount  NUMERIC( 38, 0 )                  
  DECLARE @sChk1         NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @nReturn       INT

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_inserted CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT stt_pk, stt_store, stt_commodity, stt_tax, stt_updatecount
                                          FROM inserted
      SET @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      OPEN c_inserted
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sPK, @sStore, @sCommodity, @sTax, @nUpdatecount
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
              IF (@sPK is null)
                EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sPK OUTPUT, N'STT', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
              IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                BEGIN
                  CLOSE c_inserted
                  DEALLOCATE c_inserted
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                  RETURN
                END
              INSERT INTO r5storetaxes( stt_pk, stt_store, stt_commodity, stt_tax, stt_updatecount )
              VALUES ( @sPK, @sStore, @sCommodity, @sTax, @nUpdatecount )
            END
            FETCH NEXT FROM c_inserted INTO @sPK, @sStore, @sCommodity, @sTax, @nUpdatecount
        END
      CLOSE c_inserted
      DEALLOCATE c_inserted
    END

create trigger PREINS_SWD
on R5DISPATCHES
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct        	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @dReported   	datetime            
	declare @dStart      	datetime            
	declare @dEnd        	datetime            
	declare @sOrigin     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sAssigned   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sAction     	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sCostcode   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer 
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sTypeent		nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE;  /* Type entity                           */
	declare @sStatent       nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_statent%TYPE;  /* Status entity                         */
	declare @nCountit		integer
		            

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	SWD_CODE,	SWD_DESC,	SWD_EVENT,	SWD_ACT,	SWD_REPORTED,
													  	SWD_START,	SWD_END,	SWD_ORIGIN,	SWD_ASSIGNED,	SWD_ACTION,
													  	SWD_COSTCODE,	SWD_CLASS,	SWD_ORG,	SWD_CLASS_ORG,	SWD_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	SWD_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dReported,
												@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sOrigin,	@sAssigned,	@sAction,
												@sCostcode,	@sClass,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
												@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @dReported is null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dReported OUTPUT, @sOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

								execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DISP', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_inserted
										deallocate c_inserted
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								if @nCountit >= 0
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0 
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'PREINS_SWD', N'TRIG', N'4', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end
								else
									begin
										close c_inserted
										deallocate c_inserted
										execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'OBJ', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult = N'0'
										set @sX = null
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7CKSTTP', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end


						end
					insert into R5DISPATCHES(	SWD_CODE,	SWD_DESC,	SWD_EVENT,	SWD_ACT,	SWD_REPORTED,
								             	SWD_START,	SWD_END,	SWD_ORIGIN,	SWD_ASSIGNED,	SWD_ACTION,
								             	SWD_COSTCODE,	SWD_CLASS,	SWD_ORG,	SWD_CLASS_ORG,	SWD_UPDATECOUNT)
								             
								values (	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dReported,
											@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sOrigin,	@sAssigned,	@sAction,
											@sCostcode,	@sClass,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount
									    
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dReported,
														@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sOrigin,	@sAssigned,	@sAction,
														@sCostcode,	@sClass,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_SYC
on R5SYMPTOMCLASSES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser          nvarchar(38)
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
    declare @nCountit       int
    declare @nCount         int
    declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
    declare @sGen           nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSymptom       nvarchar(8)  -- r5symptoms.syc_gen%TYPE;
    declare @nReturn        int

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_inserted cursor local for select SYC_CLASS, SYC_CLASS_ORG, SYC_SYMPTOM from inserted
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    --BEFORE EACH ROW portion
                    open c_inserted 
                    fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sSymptom
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            set @sChk = N'0'
                            set @nCountit = 0
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            set @sX = NULL

                            /* W41201 - Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = 'OBJ' ) */
                            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            if @nCountit >= 0
                                begin
                                    if @nCountit = 0
                                        begin
                                            close c_inserted
                                            deallocate c_inserted
                                            execute O7RAE N'PREINS_SYC', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end
                                end
                            else
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            SELECT @nCount = count(*)
                            FROM   r5symptoms 
                            WHERE  sym_code = @sSymptom

                            /*Symptom Code can't be general (r5symptoms) */
                            if @nCount <= 0 
                                begin
                                    close c_inserted
                                    deallocate c_inserted
                                    execute O7RAE N'PREINS_SYC', N'TRIG', N'999', @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                                begin
                                    SELECT @sGen = sym_gen
                                    FROM   r5symptoms
                                    WHERE  sym_code = @sSymptom
                                    
                                    if @sGen = N'+'
                                        begin
                                            close c_inserted
                                            deallocate c_inserted
                                            execute O7RAE N'PREINS_SYC', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
                                            rollback transaction
                                            return
                                        end
                                end
                            fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sSymptom
                        end

                    close c_inserted
                end
            deallocate c_inserted
        end

	declare @nMax        	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nTolerance  	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer   
	
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int 

	declare @sSqlidentity	nvarchar(255)

		begin

													  	TOL_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin
					open c_inserted
					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sPriority,	@nMin,	@nMax,	@nTolerance,	@nUpdatecount,
														@nSqlidentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sSqlidentity = cast(@nSqlidentity as nvarchar(255))

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted

									return
								end

					close c_inserted
				end

	declare @nTariff        	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCost          	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQty           	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sGltransferflag	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTranscode     	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTransorgid    	integer
	declare @nTransgroup    	integer
	declare @nAcd           	bigint
	declare @dGltransfer    	datetime
	declare @nUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrighours     	numeric(12,2)
	declare @sRouterec      	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nSqlidentity   	integer
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJecategory		nvarchar(25)
	declare @sJesource			nvarchar(25)
	declare @sSplitusage		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sMisc				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sInvoice           nvarchar(30)
	declare @sInvoice_org       nvarchar(15)
	declare @nInvoice_revision  numeric(8)
	declare @nInvoiceline       numeric(8)
	declare @sUnmatchedInvoice           nvarchar(45)
	declare @sUnmatchedInvoiceorg        nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUnmatchedInvoiceline       numeric(8)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	TOU_MRC,	TOU_TOOL,	TOU_EVENT,	TOU_ACT,	TOU_DATEBOOKED,
													  	TOU_DATEUSED,	TOU_HOURS,	TOU_TARIFF,	TOU_COST,	TOU_QTY,
													  	TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG,	TOU_TRANSCODE,	TOU_TRANSORGID,	TOU_TRANSGROUP,	TOU_ACD,
													  	TOU_GLTRANSFER,	TOU_UPDATECOUNT,	TOU_ORIGHOURS,	TOU_ROUTEREC,	TOU_JECATEGORY, TOU_JESOURCE,
														TOU_SPLITUSAGE, TOU_DESC, TOU_MISC, TOU_SQLIDENTITY, TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE, TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE_ORG,
														TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICELINE, TOU_INVOICE, TOU_INVOICE_ORG, TOU_INVOICE_REVISION, TOU_INVOICELINE

													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
												@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
												@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
												@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec,
												@sJecategory, @sJesource, @sSplitusage, @sDesc, @sMisc, @nSqlidentity, @sUnmatchedInvoice, @sUnmatchedInvoiceorg, 
												@nUnmatchedInvoiceline, @sInvoice, @sInvoice_org, @nInvoice_revision, @nInvoiceline

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--NOTE: IF YOU MAKE A CHANGE TO THE CODE BELOW YOU NEED TO CHANGE THE CORRESPONDING CODE IN POSINS_TOU
							if @sSplitusage <> N'N'
								begin
									--PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT
									if @sSplitusage = N'A'
										SELECT @nCount = count(*)
										FROM   r5events
										WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sEvent
										AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
											FROM   r5activities
											WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
											AND    act_act   = @nAct)
									else
										SELECT @nCount = count(*)
										FROM   r5events
										WHERE  evt_routeparent = @sEvent
										AND    ( @sSplitusage = N'O' AND evt_rstatus <> 'C' ) 
										AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
											FROM   r5activities
											WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
											AND    act_act   = @nAct)
									if coalesce( @nCount, 0 ) > 0
										begin
											--MOVED THE o7crtou1 to the POSINS_TOU trigger to avoid error 'INSTEAD OF triggers do not support direct recursion'
											  set @nOrighours = @nHours
											  set @nHours = 0
											  set @nCost = 0
										end
								end
						end
					insert into R5TOOLUSAGE(	TOU_MRC,	TOU_TOOL,	TOU_EVENT,	TOU_ACT,	TOU_DATEBOOKED,
								            	TOU_DATEUSED,	TOU_HOURS,	TOU_TARIFF,	TOU_COST,	TOU_QTY,
								            	TOU_GLTRANSFERFLAG,	TOU_TRANSCODE,	TOU_TRANSORGID,	TOU_TRANSGROUP,	TOU_ACD,
								            	TOU_GLTRANSFER,	TOU_UPDATECOUNT,	TOU_ORIGHOURS,	TOU_ROUTEREC,
												TOU_JECATEGORY, TOU_JESOURCE, TOU_SPLITUSAGE, TOU_DESC, TOU_MISC, TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE, TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICE_ORG,
												TOU_UNMATCHEDINVOICELINE, TOU_INVOICE, TOU_INVOICE_ORG, TOU_INVOICE_REVISION, TOU_INVOICELINE)
								values (	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
											@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
											@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
											@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec, @sJecategory, @sJesource, @sSplitusage, @sDesc, @sMisc,
											@sUnmatchedInvoice, @sUnmatchedInvoiceorg, @nUnmatchedInvoiceline, @sInvoice, @sInvoice_org, @nInvoice_revision, @nInvoiceline )

					/* Flag WO as to recalculate costs. */
					UPDATE r5eventcost
					SET    evo_recalccost = N'+', evo_costcalculated = N'-'
					WHERE  evo_event = @sEvent
					AND    ISNULL( evo_recalccost, N'-' ) <> N'+'

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@sEvent,	@nAct,	@dDatebooked,
														@dDateused,	@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@nQty,
														@sGltransferflag,	@sTranscode,	@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@nAcd,
														@dGltransfer,	@nUpdatecount,	@nOrighours,	@sRouterec,
														@sJecategory, @sJesource, @sSplitusage, @sDesc, @sMisc, @nSqlidentity, @sUnmatchedInvoice,
														@sUnmatchedInvoiceorg, @nUnmatchedInvoiceline, @sInvoice, @sInvoice_org, @nInvoice_revision, @nInvoiceline

				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

													  	TRN_SESSIONID,	TRN_REJECTREASON,	TRN_ORG,	TRN_CLASS_ORG,	TRN_OBJECT_ORG,
													  	TRN_FROMCODE_ORG,	TRN_TOCODE_ORG,	TRN_ORDER_ORG,	TRN_PART_ORG,	TRN_RMA_ORG,

													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nTransid,	@sSerialno,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@nTransorgid,

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return

										begin

								set @sKey2 = N'PORECV'
							else
								begin
									if @sPrcRtype = N'S'
										set @sKey2 = N'STOCKTAKE'

								end

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					insert into R5TRANSINTERFACE(	TRN_TRANSID,	TRN_SERIALNO,	TRN_SOURCESYSTEM,	TRN_SOURCECODE,	TRN_TRANSORGID,
								                 	TRN_TRANSGROUP,	TRN_CODE,	TRN_DESC,	TRN_CL

create trigger PREINS_TRS
on R5TEMPRUNSQL
instead of insert
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCode        	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sUser        	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFunction    	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sSql         	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @nRetry       	integer             
	declare @dCreated_date	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated_date	datetime            
	declare @sErrortext   	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer  
    declare @sCode          nvarchar(38)
    declare @nReturn        integer
    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)           

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	TRS_CODE,	TRS_USER,	TRS_FUNCTION,	TRS_SQL,	TRS_RETRY,
													  	TRS_CREATED_DATE,	TRS_UPDATED_DATE,	TRS_ERRORTEXT,	TRS_UPDATECOUNT,	TRS_SQLIDENTITY
													  
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nCode,	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@sSql,	@nRetry,
												@dCreated_date,	@dUpdated_date,	@sErrortext,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
											
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
                            execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCode OUTPUT, N'TRS', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
                            
                            set @nCode = cast(@sCode as numeric(38,0))
                            
                            EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @dCreated_date OUTPUT, NULL
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_inserted
									DEALLOCATE c_inserted
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END
                         	EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @dUpdated_date OUTPUT, NULL
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_inserted
									DEALLOCATE c_inserted
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN
								END
                            
                            set @nRetry = 0
                            set @nUpdatecount = 0

						end
					insert into R5TEMPRUNSQL(	TRS_CODE,	TRS_USER,	TRS_FUNCTION,	TRS_SQL,	TRS_RETRY,
								             	TRS_CREATED_DATE,	TRS_UPDATED_DATE,	TRS_ERRORTEXT,	TRS_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@nCode,	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@sSql,	@nRetry,
									    	@dCreated_date,	@dUpdated_date,	@sErrortext,	@nUpdatecount
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nCode,	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@sSql,	@nRetry,
														@dCreated_date,	@dUpdated_date,	@sErrortext,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
													
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_TUI
on R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser	nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     	bigint
	declare @dCreated     	datetime            
	declare @sSourcesystem	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sSourcecode  	nvarchar(45)        
	declare @sEvent       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nAct         	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sMrc         	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sTool        	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dDateused    	datetime            
	declare @nQty         	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nHours       	numeric(12,2)       
	declare @nTariff      	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nCost        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sTrans       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nSessionid   	integer
	declare @nTransorgid  	bigint
	declare @nTransgroup  	integer
	declare @sTranstype   	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sUser        	nvarchar(255)        
	declare @sOrg         	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sAcdalias		nvarchar(45)        
	declare @nSqlidentity 	integer        
	
	declare @nReturn		integer          
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)	 	     

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	TUI_TRANSID,	TUI_CREATED,	TUI_SOURCESYSTEM,	TUI_SOURCECODE,	TUI_EVENT,
													  	TUI_ACT,	TUI_MRC,	TUI_TOOL,	TUI_DATEUSED,	TUI_QTY,
													  	TUI_HOURS,	TUI_TARIFF,	TUI_COST,	TUI_TRANS,	TUI_SESSIONID,
													  	TUI_TRANSORGID,	TUI_TRANSGROUP,	TUI_TRANSTYPE,	TUI_USER,	TUI_ORG, TUI_ACDALIAS,
													  	TUI_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sEvent,
												@nAct,	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@dDateused,	@nQty,
												@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@sTrans,	@nSessionid,
												@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTranstype,	@sUser,	@sOrg, @sAcdalias, 
												@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sChk = null
							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nTransid OUTPUT, N'INTERFACE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7INTERFACE_ASTINT N'INSERT', @nSessionid, @sTrans, N'R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE', @nTransid, null, null, @nTransorgid, @nTransgroup, null, null
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					insert into R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE(	TUI_TRANSID,	TUI_CREATED,	TUI_SOURCESYSTEM,	TUI_SOURCECODE,	TUI_EVENT,
								                     	TUI_ACT,	TUI_MRC,	TUI_TOOL,	TUI_DATEUSED,	TUI_QTY,
								                     	TUI_HOURS,	TUI_TARIFF,	TUI_COST,	TUI_TRANS,	TUI_SESSIONID,
								                     	TUI_TRANSORGID,	TUI_TRANSGROUP,	TUI_TRANSTYPE,	TUI_USER,	TUI_ORG, TUI_ACDALIAS)
								                     
								values (	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sEvent,
											@nAct,	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@dDateused,	@nQty,
											@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@sTrans,	@nSessionid,
											@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTranstype,	@sUser,	@sOrg, @sAcdalias
									       )

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@nTransid,	@dCreated,	@sSourcesystem,	@sSourcecode,	@sEvent,
														@nAct,	@sMrc,	@sTool,	@dDateused,	@nQty,
														@nHours,	@nTariff,	@nCost,	@sTrans,	@nSessionid,
														@nTransorgid,	@nTransgroup,	@sTranstype,	@sUser,	@sOrg, @sAcdalias, 
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

on R5TAXRATEVALUES
instead of insert NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sRate       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @dStart      	datetime            
	declare @dEnd        	datetime            
	declare @nPercent    	numeric(9,6)       
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer             

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	TXV_RATE,	TXV_START,	TXV_END,	TXV_PERCENT,	TXV_UPDATECOUNT,
													  	TXV_SQLIDENTITY
													from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sRate,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@nPercent,	@nUpdatecount,
												@nSqlidentity
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @nPercent IS NULL 
								set @nPercent = 0

						end
					insert into R5TAXRATEVALUES(	TXV_RATE,	TXV_START,	TXV_END,	TXV_PERCENT,	TXV_UPDATECOUNT)
								values (	@sRate,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@nPercent,	@nUpdatecount)

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sRate,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@nPercent,	@nUpdatecount,
														@nSqlidentity
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_UCO
on R5UCODES
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEntity     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRentity    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sRcode      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sSystem     	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dCreated    	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity	integer    
    
    declare @sTextcode      nvarchar(12)         
    declare @sNotused       nvarchar(1)
	declare @sChk           nvarchar(3)
	declare @nReturn        integer
	
	declare @sIcon          nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sIconpath      nvarchar(1000)
	declare @nWeight        numeric(24,6)
	declare @sColor         nvarchar(6)
	declare @sCategory      nvarchar(30)
	declare @nGISDispatchRanking        numeric(3,0)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	UCO_ENTITY,	UCO_RENTITY,	UCO_CODE,	UCO_RCODE,	UCO_SYSTEM,
													  	UCO_DESC,	UCO_UPDATECOUNT,	UCO_CREATED,	UCO_UPDATED,	UCO_SQLIDENTITY,
													    UCO_TEXTCODE, UCO_NOTUSED, UCO_ICON, UCO_ICONPATH, UCO_WEIGHT,UCO_COLOR,UCO_CATEGORY, UCO_GISDISPATCHRANKING
												   from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sCode,	@sRcode,	@sSystem,
												@sDesc,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,
                                                @sTextcode, @sNotused, @sIcon, @sIconpath, @nWeight,@sColor,@sCategory, @nGISDispatchRanking
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @dCreated = GetDate()

						end

					if @sTextcode IS NULL
					BEGIN
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sTextcode OUTPUT, N'ATX', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						BEGIN
							CLOSE c_inserted
							DEALLOCATE c_inserted
							ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
							RETURN
						END
					END
					
					insert into R5UCODES(	UCO_ENTITY,	UCO_RENTITY,	UCO_CODE,	UCO_RCODE,	UCO_SYSTEM,
								         	UCO_DESC,	UCO_UPDATECOUNT,	UCO_CREATED,	UCO_UPDATED,
                                            UCO_TEXTCODE, UCO_NOTUSED, UCO_ICON, UCO_ICONPATH, UCO_WEIGHT,UCO_COLOR,UCO_CATEGORY, UCO_GISDISPATCHRANKING)
								values (	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sCode,	@sRcode,	@sSystem,
									    	@sDesc,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
									        @sTextcode, @sNotused, @sIcon, @sIconpath, @nWeight,@sColor,@sCategory, @nGISDispatchRanking )

					INSERT INTO r5alltexts ( atx_code, atx_texttype, atx_lang, atx_text )
					SELECT @sTextCode, N'CODE', lan_code, @sDesc
					FROM r5languages
					WHERE lan_available ='+'
					AND   NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5alltexts
									  WHERE atx_code = @sTextcode
									  AND   atx_texttype =N'CODE')

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sCode,	@sRcode,	@sSystem,
														@sDesc,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,
                                                        @sTextcode, @sNotused, @sIcon, @sIconpath, @nWeight,@sColor,@sCategory, @nGISDispatchRanking
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_UGR
on R5GROUPS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int

	declare @sPGC_usergroup			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sPGC_rentity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPGC_function			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sPGC_tabname			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sPGC_updatecount		numeric(38,0)
	declare @sPGC_jspfile			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPGC_layouttype		nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select UGR_CLASS, UGR_CLASS_ORG, UGR_DESC, UGR_CODE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							execute @nReturn = O7PREUGR N'INS', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREUGR', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'GROU', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--POSINS2_UGR
							declare c_pages cursor local for select PGC_USERGROUP, PGC_RENTITY, PGC_FUNCTION, PGC_TABNAME, PGC_JSPFILE, PGC_UPDATECOUNT, PGC_LAYOUTTYPE from r5pagecache where pgc_usergroup='R5'
							open c_pages 
							fetch next from c_pages into @sPGC_usergroup, @sPGC_rentity, @sPGC_function, @sPGC_tabname, @sPGC_jspfile, @sPGC_updatecount, @sPGC_layouttype
							while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								begin
									INSERT INTO R5PAGECACHE (PGC_USERGROUP,PGC_RENTITY,PGC_FUNCTION,PGC_TABNAME,PGC_JSPFILE, PGC_UPDATECOUNT,PGC_LAYOUTTYPE)
									values (@sCode, @sPGC_rentity,@sPGC_function,@sPGC_tabname,@sPGC_jspfile, 0, @sPGC_layouttype)

									fetch next from c_pages into @sPGC_usergroup, @sPGC_rentity, @sPGC_function, @sPGC_tabname, @sPGC_jspfile, @sPGC_updatecount, @sPGC_layouttype

								end
							close c_pages
							deallocate c_pages
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode
						end
					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_UOM
on R5UOMS
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPerType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select UOM_CLASS, UOM_CLASS_ORG, UOM_DESC, UOM_CODE from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							IF @sClass IS NOT NULL 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'UOM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'DET', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit <= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_UOM', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'UOM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_inserted into @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sCode
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_UPT
on R5USERPORTLET
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser		nvarchar(38)
	declare @sUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nPortlet    	integer
	declare @sType       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOrder      	numeric(6,0)        
	declare @nSqlidentity	int
	declare @sFunction		nvarchar(6)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select	UPT_USER,	UPT_PORTLET,	UPT_TYPE,	UPT_ORDER,	UPT_SQLIDENTITY, UPT_FUNCTION
												from inserted
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sUser,	@nPortlet,	@sType,	@nOrder,	@nSqlidentity, @sFunction
											
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if @nOrder is null 
								select @nOrder = isnull( max( upt_order ), 0) + 1
								FROM   r5userportlet
								WHERE  upt_user = @sUser

						end
					insert into R5USERPORTLET(	UPT_USER,	UPT_PORTLET,	UPT_TYPE,	UPT_ORDER, UPT_FUNCTION)
								values (	@sUser,	@nPortlet,	@sType,	@nOrder, @sFunction)

					fetch next from c_inserted into 	@sUser,	@nPortlet,	@sType,	@nOrder,	@nSqlidentity, @sFunction
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

	declare @sStart			numeric(3)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select WAC_STANDWORK, WAC_DURATION, WAC_START from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sStandwork, @sDuration, @sStart
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							/* W43201 - Class must exist ( r5classes, entity = N'OBJ' ) */
							execute @nReturn = O7PREWAC N'INS', @sStandwork, @sDuration , @sStart , @sCheckresult
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREWAC', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sStandwork, @sDuration, @sStart
						end

					close c_inserted
				end
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_WCV
on R5WARCOVERAGES
instead of insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUsr_name			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sWARRANTY			nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sOBJECT			nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sOBTYPE			nvarchar (4) 
	declare @sOBRTYPE			nvarchar (4) 
	declare @sUOM				nvarchar (30) 
	declare @nDURATION			numeric (9,2) 
	declare @nEXPIRATION		numeric (9,2) 
	declare @dEXPIRATION		datetime 
	declare @nNEARTHRESHOLD		numeric (24,6) 
	declare @nSTARTUSAGE		numeric (24,6) 
	declare @nSEQNO				int 
	declare @sACTIVE			nvarchar (1) 
	declare @dSTART				datetime 
	declare @dRECORDED			datetime 
	declare @sUSER				nvarchar (255) 
	declare @sOBJECT_ORG		nvarchar (15) 
	declare @nUPDATECOUNT		numeric (38) 
	declare @dCreated       	datetime            
	declare @dUpdated       	datetime  
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sTypeent			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE;  /* Type entity                           */
	declare @sStatent			nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_statent%TYPE;  /* Status entity                         */
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
   	declare @nCountit			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			declare c_inserted cursor local for select WCV_WARRANTY, WCV_OBJECT, WCV_OBTYPE, WCV_OBRTYPE, WCV_UOM, WCV_DURATION ,
																WCV_EXPIRATION ,WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE ,WCV_NEARTHRESHOLD, WCV_STARTUSAGE, 
																WCV_SEQNO, WCV_ACTIVE, WCV_STARTDATE, WCV_RECORDED, WCV_USER, WCV_OBJECT_ORG, WCV_UPDATECOUNT, WCV_CREATED,	WCV_UPDATED   from inserted
			set @sUsr_name = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_inserted
			fetch next from c_inserted into @sWARRANTY, @sOBJECT ,@sOBTYPE , @sOBRTYPE, @sUOM, @nDURATION ,@nEXPIRATION ,@dEXPIRATION , @nNEARTHRESHOLD, 
											@nSTARTUSAGE , @nSEQNO, @sACTIVE, @dSTART, @dRECORDED, @sUSER, @sOBJECT_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT,@dCreated,	@dUpdated	   

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUsr_name <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTO N'OBJ', @sOBTYPE, @sOBJECT, N'TYPE', @sOBJECT_ORG, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								if @nCountit > 0
									set @sX = null
								else
									begin
										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'PREINS_WCV', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXISTO', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end



								if @sOBTYPE is null 
									set @sOBRTYPE = null
								else
									begin
										execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'OBJ', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @sCheckresult = N'0'
											set @sX = null
										else
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												execute O7RAE N'O7CKSTTP', N'PROC', N'1', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										set @sOBRTYPE = @sX

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOBRTYPE OUTPUT, @sOBTYPE OUTPUT, @sTypeent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult = N'0'
										set @sX = null
									else
										begin
											if @sCheckresult <> N'999'
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_WCV', N'TRIG', N'6', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
											else
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'O7CKCODE', N'PROC',@sCheckresult, @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end




									end
								if @nSEQNO is null
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nSEQNO OUTPUT, N'WARCOVERAGE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
											end
									end

						end

					insert into R5WARCOVERAGES	(	WCV_WARRANTY, WCV_OBJECT, WCV_OBTYPE, WCV_OBRTYPE, WCV_UOM, WCV_DURATION ,
													WCV_EXPIRATION ,WCV_EXPIRATIONDATE ,WCV_NEARTHRESHOLD, WCV_STARTUSAGE, 
													WCV_SEQNO, WCV_ACTIVE, WCV_STARTDATE, WCV_RECORDED, WCV_USER, WCV_OBJECT_ORG, WCV_UPDATECOUNT, WCV_CREATED,	WCV_UPDATED    )
					values ( @sWARRANTY, @sOBJECT ,@sOBTYPE , @sOBRTYPE, @sUOM, @nDURATION ,@nEXPIRATION ,@dEXPIRATION , @nNEARTHRESHOLD, 
								@nSTARTUSAGE , @nSEQNO, @sACTIVE, @dSTART, @dRECORDED, @sUSER, @sOBJECT_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT, @dCreated,	@dUpdated  )

					fetch next from c_inserted into @sWARRANTY, @sOBJECT ,@sOBTYPE , @sOBRTYPE, @sUOM, @nDURATION ,@nEXPIRATION ,@dEXPIRATION , @nNEARTHRESHOLD, 
													@nSTARTUSAGE , @nSEQNO, @sACTIVE, @dSTART, @dRECORDED, @sUSER, @sOBJECT_ORG, @nUPDATECOUNT,@dCreated,	@dUpdated	   
				end
			close c_inserted
			deallocate c_inserted
		end

create trigger PREINS_WPK
on R5WORKPACKAGES
for insert
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJobClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sJobClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJobType		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_inserted cursor local for select WPK_CODE, WPK_DESC, WPK_ORG, WPK_CLASS, WPK_CLASS_ORG, WPK_JOBCLASS, WPK_JOBCLASS_ORG, WPK_JOBTYPE  from inserted
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_inserted 
					fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, @sJobType
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sClass is not null
								begin

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'WKPK', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_WPK', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							If @sJobClass is not null
								begin

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'EVNT', @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit >= 0
										begin
											if @nCountit = 0 
												begin
													close c_inserted
													deallocate c_inserted
													execute O7RAE N'PREINS_WPK', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
									else
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBTP', @sJobType, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nCountit >= 0
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0 
										begin
											close c_inserted
											deallocate c_inserted
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_WPK', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', @sX, N'WKPK', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return

							fetch next from c_inserted into @sCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sJobClass, @sJobClassOrg, @sJobType
						end
					close c_inserted

create trigger PREUPD2_ACS
on R5ACTSCHEDULES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sEvent				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct				numeric(8,0)
	declare @sEventTemp			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nActTemp			numeric(8,0)
	declare @sPerresp			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ACS_EVENT, i.ACS_ACTIVITY, i.ACS_UPDATECOUNT, d.ACS_UPDATECOUNT, i.ACS_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ACS_SQLIDENTITY = d.ACS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					
					create table #tProperties_acs_upd2 ( event			nvarchar(30), 
												activity		numeric(8,0))



					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @nAct, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5ACTSCHEDULES 
								set ACS_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1,
								    ACS_updated = GetDate(),
								    ACS_lastsaved = GetDate() 
								where ACS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							insert into #tProperties_acs_upd2 values (@sEvent, @nAct) 
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEvent, @nAct, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del

					--AFTER statement portion
					declare c_properties cursor local for select event, activity from #tProperties_acs_upd2
					open c_properties
					fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sPerresp = null

							SELECT @sPerresp = a.acs_responsible
							FROM  r5actschedules a
							WHERE a.acs_code in (SELECT min(b.acs_code)
										FROM r5actschedules b
										WHERE  b.acs_event   = @sEventTemp
										AND    b.acs_activity = @nActTemp
										AND    b.acs_responsible IS NOT NULL)
							if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
								set @sPerresp = null

							UPDATE r5activities
							SET    act_perresp = @sPerresp
							WHERE  act_event   = @sEventTemp
							AND    act_act     = @nActTemp
							AND    coalesce(act_perresp,N'-') <> coalesce(@sPerresp,N'-')
							if @@ERROR <> 0 
								set @sX = null

							fetch next from c_properties into @sEventTemp, @nActTemp
						end
					close c_properties
					deallocate c_properties

					drop table #tProperties_acs_upd2

				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @sProject    		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sEvent      		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject_org 		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldStatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldDebtor     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldArrangement	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @dOldStart      	datetime            
	declare @dOldEnd        	datetime            
	declare @sOldObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldProject    	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldEvent      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @nReturn		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.AGR_CODE,	i.AGR_DESC,	i.AGR_STATUS,	i.AGR_RSTATUS,	i.AGR_CLASS,
													  	i.AGR_DEBTOR,	i.AGR_ARRANGEMENT,	i.AGR_START,	i.AGR_END,	i.AGR_OBJECT,
													  	i.AGR_PROJECT,	i.AGR_EVENT,	i.AGR_ORG,	i.AGR_CLASS_ORG,	i.AGR_OBJECT_ORG,
													 	i.AGR_UPDATECOUNT,	i.AGR_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.AGR_CODE,	d.AGR_DESC,	d.AGR_STATUS,	d.AGR_RSTATUS,	d.AGR_CLASS,
													  	d.AGR_DEBTOR,	d.AGR_ARRANGEMENT,	d.AGR_START,	d.AGR_END,	d.AGR_OBJECT,
													  	d.AGR_PROJECT,	d.AGR_EVENT,	d.AGR_ORG,	d.AGR_CLASS_ORG,	d.AGR_OBJECT_ORG,
													  	d.AGR_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.AGR_SQLIDENTITY = d.AGR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
										   	@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
										   	@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@sOldClass,
											@sOldDebtor,	@sOldArrangement,	@dOldStart,	@dOldEnd,	@sOldObject,
											@sOldProject,	@sOldEvent,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldObject_org,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							-- pre_agr portion
							execute @nReturn = O7PREAGR N'UPD', @sOldCode, @sOldStatus, @sOldRstatus, @sOldArrangement, @sOldClass, 
														@sOldClass_org, @sOldDebtor, @sOldDesc, @dOldEnd, @sOldObject, @sOldProject,
														@sOldEvent, @dOldStart,
														@sCode OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sArrangement, @sClass, 
														@sClass_org, @sDebtor, @sDesc, @dEnd, @sObject, @sProject,
														@sEvent, @dStart
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							-- preupd2_agr portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update R5AGREEMENTS set	AGR_CODE         =  @sCode,	AGR_DESC         =  @sDesc,	AGR_STATUS       =  @sStatus,
						                   	AGR_RSTATUS      =  @sRstatus,	AGR_CLASS        =  @sClass,	AGR_DEBTOR       =  @sDebtor,
						                   	AGR_ARRANGEMENT  =  @sArrangement,	AGR_START        =  @dStart,	AGR_END          =  @dEnd,
						                   	AGR_OBJECT       =  @sObject,	AGR_PROJECT      =  @sProject,	AGR_EVENT        =  @sEvent,
						                   	AGR_ORG          =  @sOrg,	AGR_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	AGR_OBJECT_ORG   =  @sObject_org,
						                   	AGR_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, AGR_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where AGR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sClass,
												   	@sDebtor,	@sArrangement,	@dStart,	@dEnd,	@sObject,
												   	@sProject,	@sEvent,	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sObject_org,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@sOldClass,
													@sOldDebtor,	@sOldArrangement,	@dOldStart,	@dOldEnd,	@sOldObject,
													@sOldProject,	@sOldEvent,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldObject_org,
													@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_ARR
on R5ARRANGEMENTS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode         		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sDesc         		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass        		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sCustom_tariff		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sMat_specific 		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nLab_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nMat_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nHir_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nDma_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nFix_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nAdd_price    		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nTime_roundup 		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nMin_time     		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nTol_charge   		numeric(5,2)        
	declare @sOrg          		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org    		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount  		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity  		integer             

	declare @sOldCode         	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldDesc         	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass        	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldCustom_tariff	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldMat_specific 	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldLab_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nOldMat_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nOldHir_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nOldDma_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nOldFix_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @nOldAdd_price    	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldTime_roundup 	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOldMin_time     	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOldTol_charge   	numeric(5,2)        
	declare @sOldOrg          	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldClass_org    	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount  	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sConcat		nvarchar(50)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ARR_CODE,	i.ARR_DESC,	i.ARR_CLASS,	i.ARR_CUSTOM_TARIFF,	i.ARR_MAT_SPECIFIC,
													  	i.ARR_LAB_CHARGE,	i.ARR_MAT_CHARGE,	i.ARR_HIR_CHARGE,	i.ARR_DMA_CHARGE,	i.ARR_FIX_CHARGE,
													  	i.ARR_ADD_PRICE,	i.ARR_TIME_ROUNDUP,	i.ARR_MIN_TIME,	i.ARR_TOL_CHARGE,	i.ARR_ORG,
													 	i.ARR_CLASS_ORG,	i.ARR_UPDATECOUNT,	i.ARR_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.ARR_CODE,	d.ARR_DESC,	d.ARR_CLASS,	d.ARR_CUSTOM_TARIFF,	d.ARR_MAT_SPECIFIC,
													  	d.ARR_LAB_CHARGE,	d.ARR_MAT_CHARGE,	d.ARR_HIR_CHARGE,	d.ARR_DMA_CHARGE,	d.ARR_FIX_CHARGE,
													  	d.ARR_ADD_PRICE,	d.ARR_TIME_ROUNDUP,	d.ARR_MIN_TIME,	d.ARR_TOL_CHARGE,	d.ARR_ORG,
													  	d.ARR_CLASS_ORG,	d.ARR_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.ARR_SQLIDENTITY = d.ARR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sCustom_tariff,	@sMat_specific,
										   	@nLab_charge,	@nMat_charge,	@nHir_charge,	@nDma_charge,	@nFix_charge,
										   	@nAdd_price,	@nTime_roundup,	@nMin_time,	@nTol_charge,	@sOrg,
										   	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldCustom_tariff,	@sOldMat_specific,
											@nOldLab_charge,	@nOldMat_charge,	@nOldHir_charge,	@nOldDma_charge,	@nOldFix_charge,
											@nOldAdd_price,	@nOldTime_roundup,	@nOldMin_time,	@nOldTol_charge,	@sOldOrg,
											@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--pre_arr portion
							execute @nReturn = O7PREARR N'UPD', @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @sOldCode, @sOldCustom_tariff,
														@sOldDesc, @nOldDma_charge, @nOldFix_charge, @nOldHir_charge, @nOldLab_charge,
														@nOldMat_charge, @nOldTol_charge, @sOldMat_specific, @nOldMin_time, @nOldTime_roundup,
														@sClass, @sClass_org, @sCode, @sCustom_tariff,
														@sDesc, @nDma_charge, @nFix_charge, @nHir_charge, @nLab_charge,
														@nMat_charge, @nTol_charge, @sMat_specific, @nMin_time, @nTime_roundup
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--preupd2_arr portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

create trigger PREUPD2_BCR
on R5BARCODEREADERS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.BCR_UPDATECOUNT, d.BCR_UPDATECOUNT, i.BCR_SQLIDENTITY, i.BCR_CODE, i.BCR_DESC
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.BCR_SQLIDENTITY = d.BCR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX          =	NULL

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5BARCODEREADERS set BCR_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, BCR_LASTSAVED = getdate() where BCR_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'BARR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_CAU
on R5CAUSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CAU_UPDATECOUNT, d.CAU_UPDATECOUNT, i.CAU_SQLIDENTITY, i.CAU_CODE, i.CAU_DESC, d.CAU_CODE
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CAU_SQLIDENTITY = d.CAU_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc, @sOldCode
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5CAUSES 
								set CAU_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1,
								    CAU_UPDATED = GetDate(),
								    CAU_LASTSAVED = GetDate()
								where CAU_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CAUS', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc, @sOldCode
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sEvent,	@nIncrement,	@nLine,	@sRtype,	@sSubevent,
										   	@nSubact,	@nCost,	@nCalc,	@nCorr,	@nPrice,

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									rollback transaction
									return

						end

						                     	CEL_LASTSAVED    = getdate()
						                     
						where CEL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

		end

create trigger PREUPD2_CNH
on R5CHANGENOTICE
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode        		nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sManufact    		nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sStatus      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @dStartdate   		datetime            
	declare @dExpiredate  		datetime            
	declare @sClass       		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sDesc        		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sMfgmatchflag		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrg         		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dClosedate   		datetime            
	declare @sClass_org   		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer             
	declare @dUpdated	datetime

	declare @sOldCode        	nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sOldManufact    	nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sOldStatus      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @dOldStartdate   	datetime            
	declare @dOldExpiredate  	datetime            
	declare @sOldClass       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldDesc        	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldMfgmatchflag	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldOrg         	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dOldClosedate   	datetime            
	declare @sOldClass_org   	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38,0)   
	
	declare @sCn_cnl                	nvarchar(24)        
	declare @nCnline_cnl            	numeric(30,0)       
	declare @sOldpart_cnl           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sNewpart_cnl           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sFromobjectcode_cnl    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sToobjectcode_cnl      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sFromserialno_cnl      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sToserialno_cnl        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sFromobjectcode_org_cnl	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sToobjectcode_org_cnl  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldpart_org_cnl       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sNewpart_org_cnl       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount_cnl       	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity_cnl       	integer    
	
	declare @dCreateddate		datetime
	declare @sSeqno				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSeqno1			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sChk1			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nErecord		int
	declare @sGetUser		nvarchar(255)
	declare @dGtTime		datetime
	declare @sGetStype		nvarchar(8)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sCertnum			nvarchar(20)	--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certification%TYPE
	declare @sCerttype			nvarchar(8)		--r5personnelqualifications.pqu_certificationtype%TYPE


	         

	    

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CNH_CODE,	i.CNH_MANUFACT,	i.CNH_STATUS,	i.CNH_RSTATUS,	i.CNH_STARTDATE,
									i.CNH_EXPIREDATE,	i.CNH_CLASS,	i.CNH_DESC,	i.CNH_MFGMATCHFLAG,	i.CNH_ORG,
									i.CNH_CLOSEDATE,	i.CNH_CLASS_ORG,	i.CNH_UPDATECOUNT,	i.CNH_SQLIDENTITY, i.CNH_LASTSAVED,
									d.CNH_CODE,	d.CNH_MANUFACT,	d.CNH_STATUS,	d.CNH_RSTATUS,	d.CNH_STARTDATE,
									d.CNH_EXPIREDATE,	d.CNH_CLASS,	d.CNH_DESC,	d.CNH_MFGMATCHFLAG,	d.CNH_ORG,
									d.CNH_CLOSEDATE,	d.CNH_CLASS_ORG,	d.CNH_UPDATECOUNT
								from inserted i, deleted d
								where i.CNH_SQLIDENTITY = d.CNH_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@dStartdate,
							@dExpiredate,	@sClass,	@sDesc,	@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
							@dClosedate,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @dUpdated,
							@sOldCode,	@sOldManufact,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@dOldStartdate,
							@dOldExpiredate,	@sOldClass,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldMfgmatchflag,	@sOldOrg,
							@dOldClosedate,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin

							--preupd2
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--posupd
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CHNO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7ERECORD @nErecord OUTPUT, N'UPD', N'CHNO', @sOldStatus, @sStatus
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @nErecord > 0 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sSeqno OUTPUT, N'EREC', N'1', @sChk1 OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									
									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETUSER @sGetUser OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETSTYPE @sGetStype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYNUM @sCertnum OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									execute @nReturn = O7ESIGN_GETCERTIFYTYPE @sCerttype OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									INSERT INTO r5elecarchive ( ELA_CODE, ELA_USER, ELA_DATE,   ELA_SIGNTYPE, ELA_CERTIFYNUM, ELA_CERTIFYTYPE,
										ELA_SCODE, ELA_ENTITY,ELA_ENTCODE,ELA_ENTORG,   ELA_STATUS, ELA_PARENT,
										ELA_FLD1,  ELA_FLD2,   ELA_FLD3,   ELA_FLD4,
										ELA_FLD5,  ELA_FLD6,   ELA_FLD7,   ELA_FLD8,
										ELA_FLD9,  ELA_FLD10,  ELA_FLD11,  ELA_FLD12,
										ELA_FLD13, ELA_FLD14 )
									VALUES ( @sSeqno,	@sGetUser,	@dGtTime,	@sGetStype,		
										@sCertnum, @sCerttype,
										null,  N'CHNO',     @sCode,       @sOrg, @sStatus,          null,
										@sCode,   @sManufact,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
										cast(@dStartdate as nvarchar(30)),
										cast(@dExpiredate as nvarchar(30)),
										@sClass,	@sDesc,	@sMfgmatchflag,	@sOrg,
										cast(@dClosedate as nvarchar(30)),
										@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount, dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(@dUpdated, N'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') )
							
								
									declare c_cnl cursor local for select	CNL_CN,	CNL_CNLINE,	CNL_OLDPART,	CNL_NEWPART,	CNL_FROMOBJECTCODE,
													  	CNL_TOOBJECTCODE,	CNL_FROMSERIALN

NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CMD_SQLIDENTITY = d.CMD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin



							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5COMMANDS set CMD_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CMD_LASTSAVED = getdate()  where CMD_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity

									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sCode, @sDesc
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @nOnmax      		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOfffreq    		numeric(8,2)

	declare @nSqlidentity		integer

	declare @sOldRisk       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @nOldRiskrev    	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldConfrating 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldRevision   	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldRevrstatus 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRevstatus  	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldOnfreq     	numeric(8,2)        
	declare @nOldOnmax      	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOldOfffreq    	numeric(8,2)        
	declare @nOldOffmax     	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CRX_PK,	i.CRX_CRITICALITY,	i.CRX_RISK,	i.CRX_RISKREV,	i.CRX_CONFRATING,
													  	i.CRX_REVISION,	i.CRX_REVRSTATUS,	i.CRX_REVSTATUS,	i.CRX_ONFREQ,	i.CRX_ONMAX,
													  	i.CRX_OFFFREQ,	i.CRX_OFFMAX,	i.CRX_NOTUSED,	i.CRX_CREATED,	i.CRX_USER,
													 	i.CRX_UPDATED,	i.CRX_UPDUSER,	i.CRX_UPDATECOUNT,	i.CRX_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.CRX_PK,	d.CRX_CRITICALITY,	d.CRX_RISK,	d.CRX_RISKREV,	d.CRX_CONFRATING,
													  	d.CRX_REVISION,	d.CRX_REVRSTATUS,	d.CRX_REVSTATUS,	d.CRX_ONFREQ,	d.CRX_ONMAX,

													where i.CRX_SQLIDENTITY = d.CRX_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sCriticality,	@sRisk,	@nRiskrev,	@sConfrating,
											@nRevision,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@nOnfreq,	@nOnmax,
											@nOfffreq,	@nOffmax,	@sNotused,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
											@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldPk,	@sOldCriticality,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRiskrev,	@sOldConfrating,
											@nOldRevision,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@nOldOnfreq,	@nOldOnmax,
											@nOldOfffreq,	@nOldOffmax,	@sOldNotused,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,
											@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5CRITINDEX set	CRX_PK           =  @nPk,	CRX_CRITICALITY  =  @sCriticality,	CRX_RISK         =  @sRisk,
								            CRX_RISKREV      =  @nRiskrev,	CRX_CONFRATING   =  @sConfrating,	CRX_REVISION     =  @nRevision,
								            CRX_REVRSTATUS   =  @sRevrstatus,	CRX_REVSTATUS    =  @sRevstatus,	CRX_ONFREQ       =  @nOnfreq,
								            CRX_ONMAX        =  @nOnmax,	CRX_OFFFREQ      =  @nOfffreq,	CRX_OFFMAX       =  @nOffmax,
								            CRX_NOTUSED      =  @sNotused,	CRX_CREATED      =  @dCreated,	CRX_USER         =  @sUser,
								            CRX_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated,	CRX_UPDUSER      =  @sUpduser,	CRX_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,
								            CRX_LASTSAVED    =  getdate()
								          
						where CRX_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sCriticality,	@sRisk,	@nRiskrev,	@sConfrating,
													@nRevision,	@sRevrstatus,	@sRevstatus,	@nOnfreq,	@nOnmax,
													@nOfffreq,	@nOffmax,	@sNotused,	@dCreated,	@sUser,
													@dUpdated,	@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldPk,	@sOldCriticality,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRiskrev,	@sOldConfrating,
													@nOldRevision,	@sOldRevrstatus,	@sOldRevstatus,	@nOldOnfreq,	@nOldOnmax,
													@nOldOfffreq,	@nOldOffmax,	@sOldNotused,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,
													@dOldUpdated,	@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end
