CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD2_DCR
ON  R5DECAYCURVE
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
   DECLARE @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount      int
   DECLARE @nOldUpdateCount   int
   DECLARE @nSqlIdentity      int

   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_ins_del
         CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT  I.DCR_UPDATECOUNT, D.DCR_UPDATECOUNT, I.DCR_SQLIDENTITY
         FROM    INSERTED I, DELETED D
         WHERE   I.DCR_SQLIDENTITY = D.DCR_SQLIDENTITY
         SET @sUser  = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF  @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN  c_ins_del
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     IF ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                        UPDATE R5DECAYCURVE
                        SET    DCR_UPDATECOUNT = ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1
                        WHERE  DCR_SQLIDENTITY = @NSQLIDENTITY
                     ELSE
                        BEGIN
                           CLOSE c_ins_del
                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END

                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
                  END
               CLOSE C_INS_DEL
            END
         DEALLOCATE C_INS_DEL
      END

create trigger PREUPD2_DEB
on R5DEBTORS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sTax        		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sCurr       		nvarchar(3)         
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sType       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sNotused    		nvarchar(1) 
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldTax        	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldCurr       	nvarchar(3)         
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldType       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)  
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1) 	
	     

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.DEB_CODE,	i.DEB_DESC,	i.DEB_CLASS,	i.DEB_TAX,	i.DEB_CURR,
													  	i.DEB_ORG,	i.DEB_CLASS_ORG,	i.DEB_TYPE,	i.DEB_RTYPE,	i.DEB_UPDATECOUNT, i.DEB_NOTUSED,
													 	i.DEB_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.DEB_CODE,	d.DEB_DESC,	d.DEB_CLASS,	d.DEB_TAX,	d.DEB_CURR,
													  	d.DEB_ORG,	d.DEB_CLASS_ORG,	d.DEB_TYPE,	d.DEB_RTYPE,	d.DEB_UPDATECOUNT, d.DEB_NOTUSED
													  
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.DEB_SQLIDENTITY = d.DEB_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sTax,	@sCurr,
										   	@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@nUpdatecount, @sNotused,

											@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,	@nOldUpdatecount, @sOldNotused
										
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--pre_deb portion
							execute @nReturn = O7PREDEB N'UPD', @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, 
														@sOldCurr, @sOldDesc, @sOldTax, 
														@sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClass_org, 
														@sCurr OUTPUT, @sDesc, @sTax
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--preupd2_deb portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else

						where DEB_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sTax,	@sCurr,
										   			@sOrg,	@sClass_org,	@sType,	@sRtype,	@nUpdatecount, @sNotused,
										   			@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldTax,	@sOldCurr,
													@sOldOrg,	@sOldClass_org,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,	@nOldUpdatecount, @sOldNotused
												
				end

			deallocate c_ins_del

on R5DEPARTMENTSTRUCTURE

as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode               		nvarchar(30)

	declare @sProvider           		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sProvider_org       		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sServicecategory    		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServicecategory_org		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sServiceproblem     		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sServiceproblem_org 		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount        		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity        		integer             

	declare @sOldCode               	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldMrc                	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldProvider           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldProvider_org       	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldServicecategory    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldServicecategory_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldServiceproblem     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldServiceproblem_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount        	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.DPS_CODE,	i.DPS_MRC,	i.DPS_SUPPLIER,	i.DPS_SUPPLIER_ORG,	i.DPS_SERVICECATEGORY,
													  	i.DPS_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	i.DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM,	i.DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	i.DPS_UPDATECOUNT,	i.DPS_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.DPS_CODE,	d.DPS_MRC,	d.DPS_SUPPLIER,	d.DPS_SUPPLIER_ORG,	d.DPS_SERVICECATEGORY,
													  	d.DPS_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,	d.DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM,	d.DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG,	d.DPS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.DPS_SQLIDENTITY = d.DPS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sMrc,	@sProvider,	@sProvider_org,	@sServicecategory,
										   	@sServicecategory_org,	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
										   ,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldMrc,	@sOldProvider,	@sOldProvider_org,	@sOldServicecategory,
											@sOldServicecategory_org,	@sOldServiceproblem,	@sOldServiceproblem_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					update R5DEPARTMENTSTRUCTURE set	DPS_CODE                 =  @sCode,	DPS_MRC                  =  @sMrc,	DPS_SUPPLIER             =  @sProvider,
						                            	DPS_SUPPLIER_ORG         =  @sProvider_org,	DPS_SERVICECATEGORY      =  @sServicecategory,	DPS_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG  =  @sServicecategory_org,
						                            	DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM       =  @sServiceproblem,	DPS_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG   =  @sServiceproblem_org,	DPS_UPDATECOUNT          =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                            	DPS_LASTSAVED            = getdate()
						                            
						where DPS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sMrc,	@sProvider,	@sProvider_org,	@sServicecategory,
												   	@sServicecategory_org,	@sServiceproblem,	@sServiceproblem_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldMrc,	@sOldProvider,	@sOldProvider_org,	@sOldServicecategory,
													@sOldServicecategory_org,	@sOldServiceproblem,	@sOldServiceproblem_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_DXL
on R5DUXLAYOUT
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount			int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity			bigint
	declare @sUsergroup			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sPagename			nvarchar(40)

	declare @sLocalPagename			nvarchar(40)
	declare @sTabname			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sFuncname			nvarchar(6)
	declare @nPos				integer


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DXL_UPDATECOUNT, d.DXL_UPDATECOUNT, i.DXL_SQLIDENTITY,
												i.DXL_pagename, i.DXL_usergroup
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.DXL_SQLIDENTITY = d.DXL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sPagename, @sUsergroup
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5DUXLAYOUT set dxl_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, DXL_LASTSAVED = getdate() where DXL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							set @sLocalPagename = @sPagename

							IF @sLocalPagename = N'BSDESC'
								  update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'DES' AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'M'
							ELSE
								begin
									IF @sLocalPagename=N'BSPARA'
										update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'PAS'AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'M'
									ELSE
										begin
											IF @sLocalPagename=N'BSADRS_ADR'
												update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'ADR' AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'M'
											ELSE
												begin
													set @nPos =charindex(N'_', @sLocalPagename)

													if( @nPos > 0)
														begin
															set @sFuncname = substring(@sLocalPagename,1,@nPos-1)
															set @sTabname = substring(@sLocalPagename,@nPos+1, len(@sLocalPagename))

															update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
															where pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_function=@sFuncname
															and pgc_tabname=@sTabname and pgc_layouttype = N'M'
														end
													else
													  update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
													  where pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_function=@sLocalPagename
													  and pgc_tabname =N'HDR' and pgc_layouttype = N'M'
												end
										end
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity,  @sPagename, @sUsergroup
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD2_ECX
ON  R5ECMAXSEQ
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
   DECLARE @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount      int
   DECLARE @nOldUpdateCount   int
   DECLARE @nSqlIdentity      int

   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_ins_del 
         CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
         SELECT  I.ECX_UPDATECOUNT, D.ECX_UPDATECOUNT, I.ECX_SQLIDENTITY
         FROM    INSERTED I, DELETED D
         WHERE   I.ECX_SQLIDENTITY = D.ECX_SQLIDENTITY
         SET @sUser  = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF  @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN  c_ins_del 
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     IF ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                        UPDATE R5ECMAXSEQ 
                        SET    ECX_UPDATECOUNT = ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1 
                        WHERE  ECX_SQLIDENTITY = @NSQLIDENTITY
                     ELSE
                        BEGIN
                           CLOSE c_ins_del
                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END

                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
                  END
               CLOSE C_INS_DEL
            END
         DEALLOCATE C_INS_DEL
      END

create trigger PREUPD2_EIL
on R5EXTINVLINES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sInvoice         		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nLine            		numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sPaymentagreement		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nPaymentline     		numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sEventcode       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nEventincrement  		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nPrice           		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sInvoice_org     		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount     		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity     		integer             

	declare @sOldInvoice         	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldLine            	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sOldPaymentagreement	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldPaymentline     	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @sOldEventcode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldEventincrement  	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOldPrice           	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldInvoice_org     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount     	numeric(38,0)  
	declare @nReturn		integer

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.EIL_INVOICE,	i.EIL_LINE,	i.EIL_PAYMENTAGREEMENT,	i.EIL_PAYMENTLINE,	i.EIL_EVENTCODE,
													  	i.EIL_EVENTINCREMENT,	i.EIL_PRICE,	i.EIL_INVOICE_ORG,	i.EIL_UPDATECOUNT,	i.EIL_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.EIL_INVOICE,	d.EIL_LINE,	d.EIL_PAYMENTAGREEMENT,	d.EIL_PAYMENTLINE,	d.EIL_EVENTCODE,
													  	d.EIL_EVENTINCREMENT,	d.EIL_PRICE,	d.EIL_INVOICE_ORG,	d.EIL_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.EIL_SQLIDENTITY = d.EIL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sInvoice,	@nLine,	@sPaymentagreement,	@nPaymentline,	@sEventcode,
												   	@nEventincrement,	@nPrice,	@sInvoice_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldInvoice,	@nOldLine,	@sOldPaymentagreement,	@nOldPaymentline,	@sOldEventcode,
													@nOldEventincrement,	@nOldPrice,	@sOldInvoice_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin


							execute @nReturn = O7PREEIL N'UPD', @sOldEventcode, @nOldEventincrement, @sOldInvoice, @nOldLine,
														@sOldPaymentagreement, @nOldPaymentline, @nOldPrice, @sEventcode, @nEventincrement, 
														@sInvoice, @nLine, @sPaymentagreement, @nPaymentline,  @nPrice 

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5EXTINVLINES set EIL_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, EIL_LASTSAVED = getdate() where EIL_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sInvoice,	@nLine,	@sPaymentagreement,	@nPaymentline,	@sEventcode,
												   			@nEventincrement,	@nPrice,	@sInvoice_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldInvoice,	@nOldLine,	@sOldPaymentagreement,	@nOldPaymentline,	@sOldEventcode,
															@nOldEventincrement,	@nOldPrice,	@sOldInvoice_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

													  	d.EIV_CODE,	d.EIV_STATUS,	d.EIV_RSTATUS,	d.EIV_DEBTOR,	d.EIV_PRICE,
													  	d.EIV_TAX,	d.EIV_TAXED,	d.EIV_CURR,	d.EIV_EXCH,	d.EIV_EXCHANGED,
													  	d.EIV_DATE,	d.EIV_ORIGIN,	d.EIV_TAXPERC,	d.EIV_ORG,	d.EIV_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.EIV_SQLIDENTITY = d.EIV_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sDebtor,	@nPrice,
										   	@nTax,	@nTaxed,	@sCurr,	@nExch,	@nExchanged,
										   	@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nTaxperc,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,
										   	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@sOldDebtor,	@nOldPrice,
											@nOldTax,	@nOldTaxed,	@sOldCurr,	@nOldExch,	@nOldExchanged,
											@dOldDate,	@sOldOrigin,	@nOldTaxperc,	@sOldOrg,	@nOldUpdatecount
										
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--preupd2
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--pre_eiv

							execute @nReturn = o7preeiv  N'UPD', @sOldCode, @sOldCurr, @dOldDate,@sOldDebtor,@nOldExch,
														@nOldExchanged,@sOldOrigin,@nOldPrice,@sOldRstatus,@sOldStatus,
														@nOldTax,@nOldTaxed,@nOldTaxperc,@sOldOrg,
														@sCode, @sCurr OUTPUT, @dDate OUTPUT, @sDebtor, @nExch OUTPUT, @nExchanged OUTPUT, @sOrigin, @nPrice OUTPUT,
														@sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT , @nTax OUTPUT, @nTaxed OUTPUT, @nTaxperc OUTPUT, @sOrg OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5EXTINVOICES set	EIV_CODE         =  @sCode,	EIV_STATUS       =  @sStatus,	EIV_RSTATUS      =  @sRstatus,
						                    	EIV_DEBTOR       =  @sDebtor,	EIV_PRICE        =  @nPrice,	EIV_TAX          =  @nTax,
						                    	EIV_TAXED        =  @nTaxed,	EIV_CURR         =  @sCurr,	EIV_EXCH         =  @nExch,
						                    	EIV_EXCHANGED    =  @nExchanged,EIV_DATE         =  @dDate,	EIV_ORIGIN       =  @sOrigin,
						                    	EIV_TAXPERC      =  @nTaxperc,	EIV_ORG          =  @sOrg,	EIV_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                    	EIV_LASTSAVED    =  getdate()
						                    
						where EIV_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@sDebtor,	@nPrice,
												   	@nTax,	@nTaxed,	@sCurr,	@nExch,	@nExchanged,
												   	@dDate,	@sOrigin,	@nTaxperc,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@sOldDebtor,	@nOldPrice,
													@nOldTax,	@nOldTaxed,	@sOldCurr,	@nOldExch,	@nOldExchanged,
													@dOldDate,	@sOldOrigin,	@nOldTaxperc,	@sOldOrg,	@nOldUpdatecount
												
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_FEX
on R5FLEETEXCEPTIONS
for update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nAmount     		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sStandwork  		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sNotused    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nOldAmount     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldStandwork  	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldNotused    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)   
	
 	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)        
    declare @sX                 nvarchar(4) 	    

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FEX_CODE,	i.FEX_ORG,	i.FEX_DESC,	i.FEX_AMOUNT,	i.FEX_STANDWORK,
													 	i.FEX_NOTUSED,	i.FEX_UPDATECOUNT,	i.FEX_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.FEX_CODE,	d.FEX_ORG,	d.FEX_DESC,	d.FEX_AMOUNT,	d.FEX_STANDWORK,
													  	d.FEX_NOTUSED,	d.FEX_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.FEX_SQLIDENTITY = d.FEX_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@nAmount,	@sStandwork,
												   	@sNotused,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@nOldAmount,	@sOldStandwork,
													@sOldNotused,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update r5fleetexceptions set FEX_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, FEX_LASTSAVED = getdate() where FEX_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--posupd
							set @sX = null
                            set @sCheckresult = N'0'
                            /* Insert into 5descriptions. */
                            execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FEXC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sOrg,	@sDesc,	@nAmount,	@sStandwork,
														   	@sNotused,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldDesc,	@nOldAmount,	@sOldStandwork,
															@sOldNotused,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD2_FLC
ON  R5FIELDFILTERCLASS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
   DECLARE @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount      int
   DECLARE @nOldUpdateCount   int
   DECLARE @nSqlIdentity      int

   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_ins_del 
         CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
         SELECT  I.FLC_UPDATECOUNT, D.FLC_UPDATECOUNT, I.FLC_SQLIDENTITY
         FROM    INSERTED I, DELETED D
         WHERE   I.FLC_SQLIDENTITY = D.FLC_SQLIDENTITY
         SET @sUser  = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF  @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN  c_ins_del 
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     IF ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                        UPDATE R5FIELDFILTERCLASS 
                        SET    FLC_UPDATECOUNT = ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1, FLC_LASTSAVED = getdate() 
                        WHERE  FLC_SQLIDENTITY = @NSQLIDENTITY
                     ELSE
                        BEGIN
                           CLOSE c_ins_del
                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END

                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
                  END
               CLOSE C_INS_DEL
            END
         DEALLOCATE C_INS_DEL
      END

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FPA_AGREEMENT,	i.FPA_LINE,	i.FPA_DESC,	i.FPA_STATUS,	i.FPA_RSTATUS,
													  	i.FPA_DEBTOR,	i.FPA_CLASS,	i.FPA_DUE,	i.FPA_PRICE,	i.FPA_CLASS_ORG,
													 	i.FPA_UPDATECOUNT,	i.FPA_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.FPA_AGREEMENT,	d.FPA_LINE,	d.FPA_DESC,	d.FPA_STATUS,	d.FPA_RSTATUS,
													  	d.FPA_DEBTOR,	d.FPA_CLASS,	d.FPA_DUE,	d.FPA_PRICE,	d.FPA_CLASS_ORG,
													  	d.FPA_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.FPA_SQLIDENTITY = d.FPA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sAgreement,	@nLine,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
										   	@sDebtor,	@sClass,	@dDue,	@nPrice,	@sClass_org,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldAgreement,	@nOldLine,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,
											@sOldDebtor,	@sOldClass,	@dOldDue,	@nOldPrice,	@sOldClass_org,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							--pre_fpa
							set @sCheckresult	= N'0'
							set @sX				= null

							execute @nReturn = o7prefpa N'UPD', @sOldAgreement, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @sOldDebtor, 
									@dOldDue, @sOldDesc, @nOldLine, @nOldPrice, @sOldRstatus, @sOldStatus, 
									@sAgreement, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sDebtor OUTPUT, @dDue,  @sDesc, @nLine, 
									@nPrice, @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--preupd2
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							--posupd_eiv
							set @sTempAgreement = @sAgreement + N'#' + cast(@nLine as nvarchar(8))
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FPA', @sX, N'*', @sTempAgreement, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							set @sTempAgreement = @sOldAgreement + N'#' + cast(@nOldLine as nvarchar(8))
							execute @nReturn = o7delprv N'UPD', N'FPA', @sTempAgreement,@sOldClass, @sClass, @sOldClass_org, @sClass_org
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end 

						end
					update R5FIXEDPAYMENTS set	FPA_AGREEMENT    =  @sAgreement,	FPA_LINE         =  @nLine,	FPA_DESC         =  @sDesc,
						                      	FPA_STATUS       =  @sStatus,		FPA_RSTATUS      =  @sRstatus,	FPA_DEBTOR       =  @sDebtor,
						                      	FPA_CLASS        =  @sClass,		FPA_DUE          =  @dDue,	FPA_PRICE        =  @nPrice,
						                      	FPA_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	FPA_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                      	FPA_LASTSAVED    =  getdate()
						where FPA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sAgreement,	@nLine,	@sDesc,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,
												   	@sDebtor,	@sClass,	@dDue,	@nPrice,	@sClass_org,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldAgreement,	@nOldLine,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,
													@sOldDebtor,	@sOldClass,	@dOldDue,	@nOldPrice,	@sOldClass_org,
													@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_HOM
on R5HOME
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(24)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sGroupBy			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemp				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldGroupBy		nvarchar(80)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.HOM_CODE, i.HOM_TYPE, i.HOM_DESC, i.HOM_GROUPBYTEXT, i.HOM_UPDATECOUNT, d.HOM_UPDATECOUNT, i.HOM_SQLIDENTITY, d.hom_desc, d.hom_groupbytext
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.HOM_SQLIDENTITY = d.HOM_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sType, @sDesc, @sGroupBy, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sOldDesc, @sOldGroupBy
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5HOME set HOM_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, HOM_LASTSAVED = getdate() where HOM_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						     if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
						     	begin
									set @sTemp = @sCode + N'#' + @sType
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'HOME', @sX, N'*', @sTemp, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sType = N'C' and @sGroupBy <> @sOldGroupBy
								begin
									set @sTemp = @sCode + N'#' + @sType + N'#GB'
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'HOME', @sX, N'*', @sTemp, N'*', @sGroupBy, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sType, @sDesc, @sGroupBy, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sOldDesc, @sOldGroupBy
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @nRemqty     		numeric(24,6)

	declare @nOldInvline    	numeric(8,0)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

create trigger PREUPD2_JTA
on R5JOBTYPEAUTH
instead of update
as
    declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
    declare @sGroup      		nvarchar(12)        
    declare @sJobtype    		nvarchar(8)         
    declare @sInsert     		nvarchar(1)         
    declare @sUpdate     		nvarchar(1)         
    declare @sDelete     		nvarchar(1)         
    declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
    declare @nSqlidentity		integer             
    declare @dUpdated    		datetime            

    declare @sOldGroup      	nvarchar(12)        
    declare @sOldJobtype    	nvarchar(8)         
    declare @sOldInsert     	nvarchar(1)         
    declare @sOldUpdate     	nvarchar(1)         
    declare @sOldDelete     	nvarchar(1)         
    declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
    declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            

    declare @sStatus            nvarchar(8)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.JTA_GROUP,	i.JTA_JOBTYPE,	i.JTA_INSERT,	i.JTA_UPDATE,	i.JTA_DELETE,
													 	i.JTA_UPDATECOUNT,	i.JTA_SQLIDENTITY,	i.JTA_UPDATED,
													  	d.JTA_GROUP,	d.JTA_JOBTYPE,	d.JTA_INSERT,	d.JTA_UPDATE,	d.JTA_DELETE,
													  	d.JTA_UPDATECOUNT,	d.JTA_UPDATED, i.JTA_STATUS
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.JTA_SQLIDENTITY = d.JTA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sGroup,	@sJobtype,	@sInsert,	@sUpdate,	@sDelete,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dUpdated,
											@sOldGroup,	@sOldJobtype,	@sOldInsert,	@sOldUpdate,	@sOldDelete,
											@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldUpdated, @sStatus
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @dUpdated = getdate()

						end
					update R5JOBTYPEAUTH set	JTA_GROUP        =  @sGroup,	JTA_JOBTYPE      =  @sJobtype,	JTA_INSERT       =  @sInsert,
						                    	JTA_UPDATE       =  @sUpdate,	JTA_DELETE       =  @sDelete,	JTA_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,
						                    	JTA_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated,  JTA_STATUS       =  @sStatus,   JTA_LASTSAVED    =  @dUpdated
						where JTA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sGroup,	@sJobtype,	@sInsert,	@sUpdate,	@sDelete,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dUpdated,
													@sOldGroup,	@sOldJobtype,	@sOldInsert,	@sOldUpdate,	@sOldDelete,
													@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldUpdated, @sStatus
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_MPJ
on R5MPPROJECTS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode           		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sDesc           		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sMrc            		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dStartdate      		datetime            
	declare @dEnddate        		datetime            
	declare @sJobtype        		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sJobstatus      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sTrade          		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject         		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sObjectclass    		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sProject        		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sPriority       		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sUser           		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dDate           		datetime            
	declare @sDevice         		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sImp            		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sExp            		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sChild          		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sSesstype       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus        		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sStatus         		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sObjectclass_org		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sObject_org     		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOrg            		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sPersonnel      		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sAuxilobj       		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sTool           		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sSupplier       		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount    		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity    		integer             

	declare @sOldCode           	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldDesc           	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldMrc            	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dOldStartdate      	datetime            
	declare @dOldEnddate        	datetime            
	declare @sOldJobtype        	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldJobstatus      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldTrade          	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldObject         	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldObjectclass    	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldProject        	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldPriority       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldUser           	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldDate           	datetime            
	declare @sOldDevice         	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldImp            	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldExp            	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldChild          	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldSesstype       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus        	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldStatus         	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldObjectclass_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldObject_org     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldOrg            	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldPersonnel      	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldAuxilobj       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldTool           	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldSupplier       	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount    	numeric(38,0)   
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn				int  
	declare @sInobjectupdate		nvarchar(10)
	    

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.MPJ_CODE,	i.MPJ_DESC,	i.MPJ_MRC,	i.MPJ_STARTDATE,	i.MPJ_ENDDATE,
													  	i.MPJ_JOBTYPE,	i.MPJ_JOBSTATUS,	i.MPJ_TRADE,	i.MPJ_OBJECT,	i.MPJ_OBJECTCLASS,
													  	i.MPJ_PROJECT,	i.MPJ_PRIORITY,	i.MPJ_USER,	i.MPJ_DATE,	i.MPJ_DEVICE,
													  	i.MPJ_IMP,	i.MPJ_EXP,	i.MPJ_CHILD,	i.MPJ_SESSTYPE,	i.MPJ_RSTATUS,
													  	i.MPJ_STATUS,	i.MPJ_OBJECTCLASS_ORG,	i.MPJ_OBJECT_ORG,	i.MPJ_ORG,	i.MPJ_PERSONNEL,
													  	i.MPJ_AUXILOBJ,	i.MPJ_TOOL,	i.MPJ_SUPPLIER,	i.MPJ_UPDATECOUNT,	i.MPJ_SQLIDENTITY
													 ,
													  	d.MPJ_CODE,	d.MPJ_DESC,	d.MPJ_MRC,	d.MPJ_STARTDATE,	d.MPJ_ENDDATE,
													  	d.MPJ_JOBTYPE,	d.MPJ_JOBSTATUS,	d.MPJ_TRADE,	d.MPJ_OBJECT,	d.MPJ_OBJECTCLASS,
													  	d.MPJ_PROJECT,	d.MPJ_PRIORITY,	d.MPJ_USER,	d.MPJ_DATE,	d.MPJ_DEVICE,
													  	d.MPJ_IMP,	d.MPJ_EXP,	d.MPJ_CHILD,	d.MPJ_SESSTYPE,	d.MPJ_RSTATUS,
													  	d.MPJ_STATUS,	d.MPJ_OBJECTCLASS_ORG,	d.MPJ_OBJECT_ORG,	d.MPJ_ORG,	d.MPJ_PERSONNEL,
													  	d.MPJ_AUXILOBJ,	d.MPJ_TOOL,	d.MPJ_SUPPLIER,	d.MPJ_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.MPJ_SQLIDENTITY = d.MPJ_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sMrc,	@dStartdate,	@dEnddate,
										   	@sJobtype,	@sJobstatus,	@sTrade,	@sObject,	@sObjectclass,
										   	@sProject,	@sPriority,	@sUser,	@dDate,	@sDevice,
										   	@sImp,	@sExp,	@sChild,	@sSesstype,	@sRstatus,
										   	@sStatus,	@sObjectclass_org,	@sObject_org,	@sOrg,	@sPersonnel,
										   	@sAuxilobj,	@sTool,	@sSupplier,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity
										   ,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldMrc,	@dOldStartdate,	@dOldEnddate,
											@sOldJobtype,	@sOldJobstatus,	@sOldTrade,	@sOldObject,	@sOldObjectclass,
											@sOldProject,	@sOldPriority,	@sOldUser,	@dOldDate,	@sOldDevice,
											@sOldImp,	@sOldExp,	@sOldChild,	@sOldSesstype,	@sOldRstatus,
											@sOldStatus,	@sOldObjectclass_org,	@sOldObject_org,	@sOldOrg,	@sOldPersonnel,
											@sOldAuxilobj,	@sOldTool,	@sOldSupplier,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MSPS', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
